anubarak.note: Beetle spam build, dive their backline
anubarak.why: 47.8% wr: fine into mages, outclassed otherwise

plan.early: Poke with Impale through the wave, keep Harden Carapace for their mage rotation, never burn Burrow Charge in; it is your only out
plan.mid: Cocoon at 10: Burrow Charge the healer, Cocoon them, Impale the peelers. Start every objective fight with your engage or don't start it
plan.fight: Burrow the backline mage, Cocoon the healer, then turn and Impale divers off your carry. No charge without follow-up in range
plan.late: Epicenter at 16 widens your engage, but sustained AAs melt you late. Carapace eats spell burst; disengage when it is down

anubarak.solo: Can offlane vs casters thanks to Harden Carapace spell shield, but AA bruisers like Leoric and Sonya run him out of lane

combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts them so your Burrow Charge and Impale land the follow-up stun chain
combos.jaina: Jaina's Ring of Frost roots the clump for your Burrow Charge unburrow stun to catch them all
combos.kerrigan: Kerrigan's Impaling Blades holds them for your Cocoon and Impale to lock down the pick
combos.greymane: Greymane's Go for the Throat finishes the target your Cocoon isolates and Impale stuns

build_why: Free beetle army for waveclear and a spell-armor shield source, fuels your whole identity.
Longer, harder Burrow Charge is your engage, close onto their backline from farther out.
Refreshes Carapace off their ability damage, letting you dive into burst and survive it.
Sustain-heavy ult that keeps you alive deep in their line while chunking everyone nearby.
Adds burst to every Carapace, turning your defensive cooldown into backline damage.
Guts enemy mage output on your engage target, take it to neuter their burst combo.
A permanent free damage-and-heal pet, constant sustain and pressure between cooldowns.

plan.early: Trade with Twin Blades then back off; Blade Dash through the wave to cycle Shield Overload. Don't spend Dash as pure damage
plan.mid: Suppression Pulse at 10: blind their AA core as fights start, then Phase Prism swap their squishiest into your team
plan.fight: Prism-swap the backline carry into your team, Dash out after. Engage when Shield Overload is up, disengage when it is down
plan.late: You win long brawls: Force of Will at 16 keeps shields rolling. Blinds and roots kill you; hold Dash to escape, not chase

artanis.solo: Solid solo: out-trades sustain bruisers with Twin Blades and shield cycling; blinds (Johanna, Li Li) and Leoric make his lane miserable

combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Balls a target to you, chaining into your Phase Prism swap and Blade Dash burst
combos.arthas: Arthas Howling Blast root and Frozen Tempest slow hold the clump for your Suppression Pulse and Blade Dash
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts them while your Purifier Beam and Blade Dash melt the held clump
combos.malfurion: Malfurion's Entangling Roots pins them for your Phase Prism pull and Purifier Beam to land

build_why: Free waveclear and camp speed so you solo-lane and rotate without falling behind.
Doubles your Overload shields when low, the sustain spike that lets you brawl up front.
Front-loads Blade Dash into real burst, your poke and trade winner in lane.
Team-wide Blind shuts down an enemy auto-attack carry, best into AA-heavy comps.
More Twin Blades hits means more Shield Overload procs and steadier sustained damage.
Percent-max-HP damage lets you actually melt tanks and beefy targets over a fight.
A second Suppression Pulse for double Blind uptime, locks down their carries longer.

blaze.why: 52.5% wr: tanky waveclear, strong on nearly every map

plan.early: Hit BOTH Flame Streams on the enemy laner, drop Oil Spill on globes to zone, hold Jet Propulsion strictly for ganks
plan.mid: Bunker Drop at 10: drop it ON your team when their burst lands; everyone ports in, walks out with flamethrowers rolling
plan.fight: Ignite Oil Spill under their divers, body-block for your carry, save Jet to peel. Bunker beats Mosh and Apocalypse combos
plan.late: Juggernaut Plating at 16 makes you unkillable in oil, but percent damage still shreds you. Never fight with Bunker on CD

blaze.solo: Comfortable solo: double-soaks with long-range streams and bullies melee bruisers; Leoric and Malthael percent damage beat him

combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows the clump into your Oil Spill ignite and Combustion burn
combos.kerrigan: Kerrigan's Impaling Blades holds them for your Bunker Drop peel and Combustion ignite
combos.maiev: Maiev's Containment Disc pins a target for your Jet Propulsion charge and Oil Spill burn
combos.malfurion: Malfurion's Entangling Roots roots them into your Oil Spill and Jet Propulsion stun for the kill

blaze.trait_tip: Pyromania (trait): pop it just before enemy burst lands for 40 Armor, then stand in melee so its pulsing damage ticks on them.
build_why: Baseline self-shield sustain, keeps you frontlining and healthy through poke.
Ties Flame Stream into Oil Spill uptime, your wave-control and zoning engine.
Guts enemy mage damage when you land streams, a Spell Power debuff vs burst comps.
The peel ult, a mobile fortress your team ducks into to escape or reset a fight.
Quest ramps your Ignite damage so your zoning oil actually threatens kills.
On-demand Spell Armor plus a shield, your answer to burst mage focus.
Fixes Combustion's self-slow so you keep pace and land the ult's full slow.

chen.why: 48.0% wr but 27% ban: brew sustain bullies melee, very strong lately

plan.early: Keg Smash into Breath of Fire, weave AAs to refill brew. Drink behind the wave and bait their interrupt before committing
plan.mid: Wandering Keg at 10: bowl their team off the objective or roll one tank into your side. Never keg enemies onto your own backline
plan.fight: Stagger their engage: Flying Kick the diver, Keg Smash slow, drink through the burst. Your job is soaking CDs, not chasing kills
plan.late: You win by attrition, but every stun cancels your brew. Bait CC first, drink after; Purifying Brew at 20 removes that weakness

chen.solo: Strong solo: out-sustains Sonya and Mal'Ganis style traders; Yrel and stun-heavy laners who cancel Fortifying Brew bully him

combos.tyrael: Tyrael's El'druin's Might and Sanctification dome let your Flying Kick and Breath of Fire dive safely
combos.greymane: Greymane's Darkflight dive doubles on the target your Flying Kick and Keg Smash trap
combos.rehgar: Rehgar's Earthbind Totem slow and Bloodlust turn your Breath of Fire and Keg Smash dive into a kill
combos.abathur: Abathur's Symbiote shields and spikes you while your Wandering Keg rolls their backline apart

chen.trait_tip: Fortifying Brew (trait): drink it BEFORE the hit lands, not after, so the shield soaks their burst, and body-block while channeling.
build_why: Ability-hit self-heal is your brew-free sustain, keeps you in every brawl.
Free, empowered Flying Kick becomes your mobile poke and engage without draining brew.
Rewards brew management with speed or regen, keeps you slippery and topped up.
Unstoppable disruption barrel to scatter their backline and body-block, your signature CC.
Longer, stronger Keg Smash slow makes your disruption stickier for follow-up.
Ignite-driven Flying Kick resets keep you diving and repositioning nonstop.
Massive speed and armor on Keg turns you into an unkillable wrecking ball.

dva.why: 51.5% wr: two health bars, self-peel, objective stalling

plan.early: Boosters between two lanes to double-soak; de-meched, Big Shot the wave, hero hits refund Call Mech. Matrix their AA laner in trades
plan.mid: Bunny Hop at 10: wait for their frontline to commit, then hop the clump and keep 3+ perma-stunned on the objective
plan.fight: Defense Matrix the Tychus or Valla, Boosters to peel your healer, throw Self-Destruct into the choke as zone denial
plan.late: Losing mech to CC plus burst mid-fight is your death spiral: Matrix BEFORE stuns land, keep Self-Destruct charged for resets

dva.solo: Great solo: absurdly hard to kill and Boosters double-soak; Leoric out-trades pilot form and percent damage melts the mech

combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Balls their backline into the center of your Self-Destruct radius
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc locks a hero inside your Self-Destruct blast zone
combos.falstad: Falstad Mighty Gust pushes them back onto your ticking Self-Destruct mech
combos.deckard: Deckard Scroll of Sealing roots them where your Self-Destruct bomb will detonate

build_why: More mech Health plus fusion-cannon lifesteal; the frontline sustain to body-block on the point longer.
Boosters deal percent-Health damage and heal you; turns your engage into real burst and sustain vs tanks.
Boosters grant team speed and refresh faster when undamaged; keeps you mobile for repeated zoning and peels.
Burst damage that combos off Boosters; the kill-pressure pick over the purely defensive Bunny Hop.
Defense Matrix shreds armor and slows; converts your skillshot-denial zone into a damage-amp for your team.
Boosters grant a shield and ramp attack damage per hero hit; your bruiser spike for diving their clump.
Extends Bunny Hop and stops decay while stationary; turns the ult into a long AoE zone-lock on the point.

diablo.note: Flip combos near walls, feed souls first

plan.early: Stack souls fast: trade with Shadow Charge into Overpower under your own gate, Fire Stomp the wave. At 100 souls play fearless
plan.mid: Lightning Breath at 10: flip a target with Overpower first, then breathe while Unstoppable. Charge their mage on objectives
plan.fight: Charge a squishy into your team, or Overpower their diver back onto your carry as the peel. Aim Fire Stomps into the clump
plan.late: Hellgate at 20 flips fights alone, but at 0 souls you are paper. Never chain deaths; the 100-soul buff IS your tankiness

diablo.solo: Workable solo with Fire Stomp sustain, punishes immobile laners near walls; percent damage and Garrosh tosses ruin him

combos.thrall: Thrall Sundering walls and stuns them into your Shadow Charge and Overpower slam
combos.tassadar: Tassadar Force Wall traps them in place for your Apocalypse stun and Overpower combo
combos.medivh: Medivh Polymorph disables a target so you land Shadow Charge into Overpower cleanly
combos.tyrande: Tyrande Lunar Flare stuns them for your Shadow Charge, Overpower, and Apocalypse chain

build_why: Souls boost globe and fountain healing; the soak-and-sustain pick to stay healthy while stacking your bulk.
Fire Stomp generates souls and heals; your in-combat soul engine that fuels the Health-per-soul trait.
Attacks slash Shadow Charge and Overpower cooldowns; lets you chain your CC combos far more often.
Unstoppable channel for reliable zone damage; take over Apocalypse when you want anti-dive and self-peel.
Stunning with Charge or Overpower ramps your attack speed; converts your combo into real follow-up auto damage.
Two extra Overpower charges; more displacement and stuns to flip multiple targets into your team.
Huge Apocalypse CD refund per hero hit plus a free death-cast; gives you near-constant lockdown ult uptime.

etc.note: Mosh threat wins fights, powerslide engage
etc.why: 48.6% wr: Mosh into a stacked team still swings games

plan.early: Play safe soak, heal with Guitar Solo, slide only through the wave with an exit. Powerslide is engage AND escape, never both
plan.mid: Mosh Pit at 10: slide-stun only when it does not risk your Mosh; Face Melt their engage, then Mosh the re-clump on objectives
plan.fight: Powerslide the backline, hold Mosh for a 3+ clump, count their interrupts first. Face Melt peels divers off your healer
plan.late: A landed late Mosh wins the game and a cancelled one loses it. Track every enemy stun and channel-breaker before you press R

etc.solo: Rarely solos; only offlane on huge maps with a Stage Dive build, otherwise keep him main tank

combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts their team, then you channel Mosh Pit uninterrupted
combos.greymane: Greymane Worgen dive burst cleans up the heroes your Mosh Pit stun-locks
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns anyone trying to interrupt your Mosh Pit channel
combos.alarak: Alarak Deadly Charge stuns their group together for your full Mosh Pit

build_why: Ramps Guitar Solo healing into real teamfight sustain; the standard scaling pick to stay healthy in fights.
Powerslide over walls with a CD refund on a miss; your flexible engage or escape angle and free re-engages.
Face Melt smashes anyone recently Powerslid; your burst combo to punish targets you just knocked.
Your wombo and the whole reason to draft ETC: a 4-second AoE stun that sets up every follow-up on your team.
Face Melt leaves a second knockback and refunds CD per hero hit; more disruption and faster ability uptime.
35 armor after Powerslide; take when you dive so you survive the focus right after engaging.
Mosh refreshes Powerslide and can extend Mosh; engage, stun, then reposition or lengthen the wombo.

garrosh.note: Throw divers into your team, anti-dive king
garrosh.why: 53.6% wr + 39% ban: throw into your team is a free kill

plan.early: Trade under your tower: Groundbreaker pull, Wrecking Ball toss into tower shots, Bloodthirst back up. You are strongest at low HP
plan.mid: Decimate at 10: spam the slow on objectives and toss their bruiser into your team the second your mage has cooldowns
plan.fight: Toss the diver off your healer, or flip their carry into your team. Armor Up means you tank BETTER while low; don't panic out
plan.late: Late, every Wrecking Ball should trade a kill. Watch for Unstoppable and Iron Skin timers; toss the target who cannot answer

garrosh.solo: Fine solo: nearly ungankable at low HP under tower; loses pure sustain wars to Mal'Ganis and percent-damage laners

combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them so you walk in and Wrecking Ball the frozen backline
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns a target for your Groundbreaker and Wrecking Ball toss
combos.zarya: Zarya Graviton Surge pulls their team together for your Warlord's Challenge taunt
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a carry for you to Wrecking Ball into your team

build_why: Quest adds a big DoT to Groundbreaker's stun; take for kill pressure and to reward landing your primary CC.
Bloodthirst resets and refunds on kills plus sustain; your lane-sustain and self-heal engine to stay topped.
Groundbreaker slows enemy attack speed; the anti-auto-attacker pick to blunt their carry's DPS.
An AoE taunt that flips a dive: silence and force their whole clump to attack you instead.
A shield when Groundbreaker stuns; keeps you alive after committing your engage CC into their team.
Chaining stun into Wrecking Ball slashes its CD; lets you throw enemies far more often, your signature play.
Wrecking Ball throws two enemies; double the displacement to yank multiple divers into your team.

johanna.why: 52.3% wr + 55% ban, most banned hero: safe, blind-pickable, unkillable

plan.early: Punish the melee laner on CD, Shield Glare their AA windows, Iron Skin AFTER their stun commits. Condemn drags the wave for clears
plan.mid: Blessed Shield at 10: open fights by stunning two, or bank it to interrupt Mosh Pit and Ring of Frost on objectives
plan.fight: Walk at their carry, Condemn pull into Punish, keep the AA hero Glared all fight. Iron Skin their engage; you cannot be peeled
plan.late: Your risk is tanking with no threat: hit multi-hero Glares for Holy Renewal at 16 and hold Iron Skin to eat their wombo

johanna.solo: Safe solo into anything and blunts AA bruisers with Glare; low kill threat means Dehaka or Leoric happily out-soak her

combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes their group for your Condemn pull and Blessed Shield
combos.blaze: Blaze Bunker Drop and Flame Stream corral them into your Condemn stun radius
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc traps a hero for your Falling Sword and Punish follow-up
combos.deckard: Deckard Scroll of Sealing roots them into your Condemn pull and Blessed Shield

johanna.trait_tip: Iron Skin (trait): activate as you get focused or CC'd; the shield makes you Unstoppable, so use it to break a stun or eat burst, not preemptively.
build_why: Stacks physical armor off your autos plus bonus health, the backbone of her near-unkillable frontline.
Non-decaying 80% slow when you clip two heroes, locks a target in place for your team to collapse.
Punish shuts off enemy healing, take it into heavy-sustain comps where your kills otherwise slip away.
Global engage that makes allies under you unstoppable, your initiation or a save from across the map.
Big Punish damage when it clips multiple targets, adding real teamfight burst on top of the slow.
Condemn now weakens and slows, a peel tool that blunts their dive and buys a diving ally an out.
A full-health shield the instant you'd die, the reason she anchors a fight no one can break through.

malganis.why: 49.6% wr: sleep + sustain, fell off after nerfs

plan.early: Weave AAs between Fel Claws swipes, the third swipe stuns for a free trade. Necrotic Embrace shrugs poke; sleep ganks with Night Rush
plan.mid: Carrion Swarm at 10: stun with the third Fel Claws swipe, then swarm through 3+ heroes to heal back to full mid-fight
plan.fight: Night Rush their healer to sleep, chain Fel Claws stuns onto the carry. Every extra hero you hit is extra healing; fight in the pile
plan.late: Plague Bats at 16 turns swarm into a fight-winner; hard CC during it is your death. Bait stuns, then commit and outlast them

malganis.solo: Elite solo sustain: out-heals nearly every bruiser trade; ranged offlaners and healing reduction (Ana) neuter him

combos.kelthuzad: Kel'Thuzad Chains roots the group for your Fel Claws and Carrion Swarm sweep
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost locks them inside your Night Rush and Fel Claws
combos.sonya: Sonya Wrecking Ball or dive pairs with your Sleep to lock a target down
combos.illidan: Illidan dives in while your Sleep and Vampiric bulk keep the engage alive

build_why: Your baseline tankiness vs autos, stack armor by hitting their frontline so you shrug off attacks while draining.
Cranks Necrotic Embrace uptime and AoE, more armor procs and more sustain in a clump.
Sets up your kill pressure, the armor shred amps your and your team's follow-up burst on a target.
Invulnerable escape that also deals damage, dodge their combo mid-fight then keep draining.
Longer sleep to take their carry out of the fight, your signature pick to set up a kill from the flank.
Adds real burst to your rotation, take it when you need damage over pure tankiness.
Turns your single-target sleep-kill into AoE burst, punishes them for grouping near the target.

muradin.why: 47.8% wr on a huge sample, but the safest tank floor in the game

plan.early: Hold Storm Bolt until Thunder Clap's slow guarantees it, soak and let Second Wind top you off, Dwarf Toss over terrain resets ganks
plan.mid: Avatar at 10: pop it entering the objective fight and eat their CC as the sponge; if it is down, do not start fights
plan.fight: Peel first: Thunder Clap the divers, Storm Bolt the kill target when your team commits, Dwarf Toss out last
plan.late: Avatar plus Second Wind is near-immortal vs spell comps, but Tychus-style percent damage ignores it. Never Toss INTO five

muradin.solo: Classic safe solo: escapes any gank with Dwarf Toss and heals it off; sustain traders like Mal'Ganis slowly win the lane

combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse stuns first so your Dwarf Toss in and Storm Bolt chain the lockdown
combos.kerrigan: Kerrigan Impaling Blades roots the group for your Storm Bolt and Thunder Clap to pile on
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns from range so your Dwarf Toss and Storm Bolt collapse on the target
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them for your Storm Bolt stun and Thunder Clap slow to stick

build_why: Your infinite sustain, stay topped between fights so you can body-block and peel without recalling.
Extra wave clear and poke, and it doubles your slow zone to lock down their frontline.
Adds a strong slow to your leap, gap-close and peel divers off your backline.
Your unkillable engage button, dive in as a giant meatshield and soak their whole combo.
Sustain scaled to their clump, spam Clap in a teamfight to stay full while you peel.
An on-demand full heal to survive focus, take it vs burst comps that try to blow you up.
Double stun, clap and toss in one fight, your peel and CC output doubles at the key moment.

stitches.note: One hook wins the fight, play brush
stitches.why: 47.2% wr: hook value is real, everything else is slow

plan.early: Hook only clean lanes, it stops on minions. Slam clears and dismounts roamers; Devour the bruiser to out-sustain trades
plan.mid: Gorge at 10: Hook the healer, walk them into your team, then Gorge whoever comes to save them. Hold Hook to break channels
plan.fight: One button wins it: Hook their carry into five allies. Follow with Gorge on the second target, Slam slow to peel after
plan.late: Master Hooker at 20 makes picks constant: hook from fog, never from plain sight. A missed hook means playing the fight 4v5

stitches.solo: Decent solo: Devour keeps him topped forever; percent damage (Malthael, Tychus flex) and slippery laners like Dehaka beat him

combos.blaze: Blaze Combustion slows them so your Hook lands and Slam grinds the clump
combos.falstad: Falstad Mighty Gust pushes them together so your Slam and Putrid Bile hit the whole group
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse stuns so your Hook and Gorge pull the target out for the team
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them for a guaranteed Hook into Slam and Gorge

stitches.trait_tip: Shambling Horror (trait) as you dive: 4s of slow-immunity plus Vile Gas, so Hook and Slam through the enemy team while they cannot kite you.
build_why: Devour quest ramps regen and Vile Gas damage, the stacking sustain that makes Stitches a real frontline.
Attacks and Slam refund Slam cooldown, near-constant Slam for waveclear and to keep enemies in your gas.
Hook deals percent damage and refunds cooldown and mana, one hook chunks hard and you hook again sooner.
Self-speed and a slowing damage aura, your engage and chase tool to stick a hooked target and gas the group.
Hook heals you big over 5 seconds, the sustain to hook into their team and survive the return focus.
Slam adds a heavy slow and armor shred, peel for your team and set up your carry to delete the target.
Bile double damage plus a death-timer quest, turns your aura into real damage and fast respawns.

tyrael.why: 56.2% wr on a real sample: sanctification answers every engage

plan.early: Poke with El'druin's Might and teleport back out, Smite the wave edge for move speed rotations, Righteousness BEFORE damage lands
plan.mid: Judgment at 10 to dive carries after escapes are down; take Sanctification instead when they run Mosh or KTZ wombo
plan.fight: El'druin in, Righteousness your diver, Smite speed the chase. Even dying works: your death bomb zones their backline
plan.late: You enable the carry, not yourself: hold Sanctification for their R combo. Sancting nothing is how late fights get lost

tyrael.solo: Flex solo: very safe with El'druin escapes but low kill pressure; Arthas and Blaze out-trade him all lane

combos.illidan: Illidan dives and pins the backline so your El'druin blink and Judgment land clean
combos.alarak: Alarak Deadly Charge stuns a group so your Judgment and Righteousness follow up
combos.sgthammer: Sgt. Hammer Concussive Blast knocks back and stuns so your Judgment charge connects
combos.ltmorales: Lt. Morales Healing Beam sustains you as you dive in with Judgment and Righteousness

tyrael.trait_tip: Archangel's Wrath (trait): when you die your corpse drifts and explodes after 4s, so steer it into the enemy team for 450 burst and a faster respawn.
build_why: Shares your shield with allies, turning Righteousness into a team-wide save, core to enabling dive.
Armor on your teleport lets you dive in and El'druin back out without dying.
Shield explosion adds damage to your engages, punishing enemies clumped on your dived ally.
The reason you draft Tyrael: an invuln bubble that eats their wombo, hold it for their combo ult.
Walls off your teleport landing, peel a diver off your carry or trap a target in.
Attacks lower El'druin's cooldown, more teleports means more repositioning and shield uptime.
Attack speed on every ability cast keeps your shield engine and self-sustain rolling.

chogall.note: Two heads one body, only with a duo partner

plan.early: Two players, one body: soak the safest lane, Cho lands close-range Rune Bombs so Gall detonates Runic Blast on cooldown
plan.mid: Hammer of Twilight plus Twisting Nether at 10: Surging Fist in, Hammer stun, Nether the clump; Gall never stops Shadowflame
plan.fight: You ARE the frontline: Fist their carry, Hammer the peeler, Gall dumps Shadowflame and Dread Orb nonstop. Leave at 50%, not 20%
plan.late: You feed double XP when you die: never get caught solo. C'Thun's Gift and Twilight Frenzy at 20 win any grouped fight

combos.ana: Ana's Nano Boost and Healing Dart amp Gall's burst and sustain your massive shared health bar
combos.auriel: Auriel's Ray of Heaven burst-heals your huge shared HP while Crystal Aegis covers your Surging Fist dive
combos.brightwing: Brightwing's Blink Heal and Pixie Dust keep your two-headed body alive through a deep Surging Fist engage
combos.yrel: Yrel's Sanctification dome and Gift of the Naaru heal cover your Ogre Hurl dive and Gall's burst

chogall.trait_tip: Ogre Hide (trait): toggle on for 25 Armor when Cho'gall is focused, but turn it off when you're winning so Gall keeps full damage.
build_why: Ramps your Blaze self-heal when Ignited, the sustain that keeps the shared body alive.
Percent-HP damage and a cooldown cut on Surging Fist, your repeatable engage burst.
Slow plus speed on Fist makes your charge stick, catching targets for your Ogre partner.
A reliable stun and knockback that sets up your co-pilot's whole combo.
Self-heals while charging Fist, letting the body brawl through incoming damage.
Attack-speed spike after Fist turns your engage into heavy sustained damage.
Shorter death timer, critical since one death removes two players from the map.

dehaka.why: 50.7% wr + 14% ban: global bruiser, drags win games

plan.early: Soak two lanes with Brushstalker, eat essence globs, and save the Essence Collection burst heal for when a gank actually lands.
plan.mid: Isolation at 10: silence-blind their carry, then Drag them into your team. Brushstalker to the objective the second it spawns.
plan.fight: Ambush from a bush, weave an auto first, then Drag the backliner over the wall into your team. Hold essence until they burn burst.
plan.late: Late you win on cross-map Brushstalker picks; Isolation plus Drag makes every fight 4v5. Kite comps like Valla are your death.

dehaka.solo: Safe, sustainy solo laner who bullies immobile bruisers and never misses soak; ranged kite laners and blind comps outlast him.

combos.anubarak: Anub'arak Cocoon pins a hero so your Drag and Isolation land uncontested for the kill
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them in place for your Drag pull and free melee burst
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns from range, setting up your Drag and Isolation silence
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc traps a hero for your guaranteed Drag and Isolation follow-up

build_why: Spell armor while Dark Swarm is up; the survivability to dive in and sustain through their magic burst.
Doubles essence from takedowns and swarm hits so you reach max Health faster; the standard growth pick.
Attacks refund Drag's cooldown and extend it; keeps your isolate-and-drag lockdown online every fight.
The reason you draft Dehaka to pick a carry: silence, slow and reveal to yank one target from their team.
Amps Dark Swarm damage and adds a slow while roam speed is up; your ganking and brawl damage spike.
More Drag range so you hook from further and isolate deeper into their backline.
Isolation now hits everyone near the target; turns a single pick into a team-wide silence wombo.

deathwing.why: 52.2% wr: unstoppable stat monster, punishes cc-light comps

plan.early: Land at full armor, clear waves in World Breaker from range, and lift out before the plates melt. Never fight below half armor.
plan.mid: Cataclysm the objective start: the burn zone forces them off the point. Drop Destroyer form on their backline when your team commits.
plan.fight: You are permanently unstoppable: land on the clump, Onslaught stun the carry, Incinerate, then Dragonflight out before you go red.
plan.late: Late the risk is percent damage, Tychus and Giant Killer shred plates. Leave at half armor, reset in the sky, re-drop for round two.

deathwing.solo: Fine solo pick: World Breaker poke bullies melee bruisers who cannot trade back; Malthael and percent-damage laners send him home.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit locks a clump in place for your Molten Flame breath and Lava Burst to roast them all
combos.arthas: Arthas Howling Blast roots a target and Frozen Tempest slows the group under your Molten Flame breath
combos.johanna: Johanna's Condemn pulls them into one pile for your Firestorm and Molten Flame to melt
combos.muradin: Muradin's Stormbolt stun and Haymaker knockback pin a target under your Molten Flame breath

build_why: Your only sustain since you can't be healed; attack lifesteal keeps armor plates up so you can brawl and flank.
Destroyer-form AoE that pressures clumped teams and clears waves; take when you want teamfight and lane zone.
Adds ranged meteor pressure after Dragonflight; chip poke that punishes grouped enemies from safety.
Amps Cataclysm's DoT and resets it on structure kills; snowball a sieging lead into repeated map-wide damage.
Makes Molten Flame sustainable so you channel it longer; the pick when you're the Destroyer-form face-melter.
Adds a burn execute to Molten Flame for real burst on the tanks and heroes you sustain the beam on.
Turns Cataclysm's scorched ground into a slow zone so enemies can't escape your follow-up damage.

gazlowe.note: Zone bully, take camps on cooldown
gazlowe.why: 55.2% wr: turret zone control bullies most solo laners

plan.early: Hide Rock-It Turrets in bushes by the wave, Xplodium under it, collect scrap. You outclear everyone, so shove and take early camps.
plan.mid: Grav-O-Bomb at 10: hold it until they clump on the objective, pull them into Xplodium's stun, then turrets and Deth Lazor eat the pile.
plan.fight: Set turrets BEFORE the fight and make them come to your nest. Grav-O into Xplodium is the wombo; never open with the bomb alone.
plan.late: Late you win zone control: pre-stack turret nests on the point. Long-range poke like Chromie dismantles the nest before anyone enters.

gazlowe.solo: Sturdy solo laner on his turret nest; melee who must step into it lose, but ranged laners like Lunara poke him off his scrap for free.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds them still over your Xplodium Charge and Deth Lazor
combos.diablo: Diablo Apocalypse stuns their team into your Grav-O-Bomb and turret crossfire
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them on top of your Xplodium Charge detonation
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a target for your Deth Lazor and Xplodium Charge

build_why: More Scrap and faster regen off attacks; fuels your ability rotation and your camp and waveclear tempo.
Turret casts shield you; free survivability so you can hold your zone under pressure.
Deth Lazor refunds 3 Scrap per hero hit; landing your poke supercharges your ability uptime.
An AoE pull that clumps enemies and amps your follow-up; the wombo-setup heroic for your team's burst.
Turrets hit extra targets at longer range; stronger zone control plus camp and waveclear.
All your turrets fire a Deth Lazor with you; massive burst once you've set up a turret field.
Stacking armor and bonus damage to CC'd enemies; your late-game bruiser survivability and wombo payoff.

plan.early: Charge the bruiser through the minion line, stack Valor with W and E, consume with AAs. Flash of Anger at 7 wins every trade
plan.mid: Wrath of the Angiris at 10: lift the carry and drop them inside your team, but only when follow-up CC is ready to land
plan.fight: Lay Solarion's Fire, Charge-pin their carry along it, Molten Armor the marked target. Vs dive, save Charge to peel your healer
plan.late: Late Wraths must hit the carry with your team set to catch; you are airborne and useless for 2s, so time it as the opener

imperius.solo: Top-tier solo bully: beats Sonya, Artanis, and The Butcher head-on; ranged kiters and Sgt. Hammer deny his Charge

combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them for your Celestial Charge and Solarion's Flare burst
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds them still for your Solarion's Flare and Valorous Brand burst
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Earthbind Totem roots a target for your Celestial Charge stun follow-up
combos.malganis: Mal'Ganis Fel Claws stun sets up your Celestial Charge and Wrath of the Angiris

imperius.trait_tip: Valorous Brand (trait): after a Basic Ability, weave in Basic Attacks to consume the marks for bonus damage and a big self-heal, best when you're low.
build_why: Rewards stacking Valorous Brand before you stun, more marks means a longer Charge stun and a lower cooldown.
Globe armor and refreshed regen when you trade, the sustain that wins his solo lane against other bruisers.
Turns your marks into burst plus a shield, the spike that lets a Charge combo actually delete a squishy.
A big on-demand shield that fires back damage, the safer ult when you need to survive the dive you start.
Every mark you consume refreshes Molten Armor, keeping your sustain and waveclear engine running in fights.
Move and attack speed after every Charge, take it to stick to targets and cash the stun in with autos.
Refills a big chunk of health and mana when you dive in, the reset that lets you commit fight after fight.

leoric.note: Percent-damage tank shredder, never truly dies

plan.early: Skeletal Swing slow first so the full Drain Hope channel sticks; even dead you keep soaking as Undying, so never leave lane XP
plan.mid: Entomb at 10: box the healer against a wall on the objective, Drain Hope inside while your team collapses on them
plan.fight: March at the biggest health bar, Drain their tank's percent HP, Wraith Walk through bodies to reach the healer. Die AFTER it's won
plan.late: Buried Alive at 20 removes their carry for 4s: open fights with it. Mobile heroes walk out of Entomb; trap against walls only

leoric.solo: Premier solo soaker: even his corpse soaks XP; Dehaka out-rotates him and Samuro or Tracer dodge everything he throws

combos.diablo: Diablo Shadow Charge knocks a target into your Skeletal Swing and Drain Hope
combos.orphea: Orphea Dread pulls enemies in for your Skeletal Swing and Entomb wall
combos.stukov: Stukov Lurking Arm silences a group inside your Entomb trap
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost locks them for your Entomb and Skeletal Swing combo

leoric.trait_tip: Undying (trait): as a ghost after death, drift toward the fight so you resurrect in position, not off in base; use the downtime to stay relevant.
build_why: A big self-heal on demand refreshed by globes, the sustain that lets him out-brawl anyone who pokes him.
A stronger Skeletal Swing slow, take it to stick to a target or peel a dive off your backline.
Drain Hope heals a huge chunk of his health, the tether becomes a full lifeline in extended fights.
A wall ult that splits their team or traps a target, your setup for a kill or a clutch peel.
Drain Hope's cooldown melts while it's active, keeping the tether and its damage and heal up almost always.
Full-duration Drain Hope rips max-health damage, the payoff that makes him a genuine tank-shredder.
The final ult swing tethers everyone nearby with Drain Hope, chaining lockdown and damage across their team.

malthael.note: Melts tanks, useless into ranged kite
malthael.why: 55.4% wr: percent damage shreds tanks and bruisers

plan.early: One Death Shroud marks the whole wave and Soul Rip heals it back. Trade into any melee freely, your percent damage always wins.
plan.mid: Last Rites at 10: mark, shave them under the execute line, cash it. Do not sit on it, a guaranteed kill is worth the cooldown.
plan.fight: Live on their frontline: keep two or three marked, Soul Rip on cooldown, Wraith Strike through the tank to tag the backline when safe.
plan.late: Late you melt 20-stack tanks and Last Rites the biggest one at 25 percent. Blinds and kiting blank you, pick your moment to stick.

malthael.solo: Solid solo vs tanky bruisers he shreds with marks; Fenix and ranged offlaners kite him and Lunara's poison outtrades Soul Rip.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds the team while your Reaper's Mark and Death Shroud drain them
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball groups enemies for your Wraith Strike dive and Tormented Souls
combos.medivh: Medivh Portal and Force of Will let your Wraith Strike dive deep and escape
combos.ana: Ana Nano Boost supercharges your Tormented Souls teamfight drain

build_why: More gap-close and reset range on Wraith Strike, stick to fleeing targets and chain-reset through a fight.
Your main DPS and Reaper's Mark applicator, cheaper and wider so you keep marks on their whole team.
Sticky slow to catch kiters, closes the gap so ranged heroes can't peel you off.
Marks their whole team for massive sustained AoE, your teamfight ult that also heals you through it.
Turns tanks into your health pack, out-sustain their frontline while you shred it.
More frequent Soul Rips means more healing and DPS, ramps your bruiser sustain engine.
Keeps your AoE mark rolling as long as you get kills, snowballs a won teamfight into an ace.

ragnaros.why: 49.2% wr: lava wave wins push maps

plan.early: Offlane: Empower Sulfuras clears the wave and heals in one swing, Living Meteor the camp. Trade around trait, back off without it.
plan.mid: Lava Wave at 10: send it down the opposite lane the moment the objective starts. It erases the wave and forces a defender home.
plan.fight: Second-line bruiser: let your tank open, then Empower cleave their front and Blast Wave out. Never lead, you have no escape when focused.
plan.late: Late, Molten Core turns a fort defense into a won fight; Sulfuras Smash the CC'd clump. Displacement like Garrosh ruins your trait.

ragnaros.solo: Premier solo laner: Empower sustain beats most bruisers and he never misses soak; Chen and Garrosh displacement give him fits.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit pins a clump so your Living Meteor rolls through them for the full duration
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns from range so your Living Meteor and Sulfuras Smash land clean
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse stuns so your Living Meteor and Empower Sulfuras hit uncontested
combos.ana: Ana Nano Boost amps your damage so Living Meteor and Molten Core swings burn them down

ragnaros.trait_tip: Molten Core (trait) on an allied or destroyed Fort/Keep for burst siege or teamfight tempo; it burns away in ~18s, so pop it when it swings the moment.
build_why: Ramps Living Meteor damage on repeat hits and quests for more, your poke and waveclear engine, land it repeatedly.
Blast Wave slow gives you the self-peel and setup to keep meteors landing on a fleeing target.
Empower resets fast on 2+ hero hits, near-infinite empowered attacks to shove waves and sustain in brawls.
Your burst and engage ult, a long-range slam for a pick or to zone, huge center damage on a caught target.
Empower heals off hero damage, the sustain that lets you brawl on the frontline and hold a losing lane.
Living Meteor explodes for a second hit, a big AoE burst spike that punishes grouped enemies.
Your escape and reset, stasis and heal to bait cooldowns then re-engage, survives a full combo dumped on you.

rexxar.note: Solo lane + camps, Misha peels dive
rexxar.why: 57.9% wr but thin sample: misha controls the solo lane

plan.early: Send Misha into the wave while you auto from range; park her in the gank bush. You never miss soak and duo camps early with her.
plan.mid: Unleash the Boars at 10: fire it as they rotate to the objective to reveal and slow all five, then collapse with the Misha stun.
plan.fight: Misha, Charge! the diver off your healer and body-block skillshots with her; you stay on the edge with autos and Spirit Swoop slows.
plan.late: Late you split the map: Misha holds a lane or point alone while you fight. Mobile assassins who ignore Misha and jump you are the risk.

rexxar.solo: Elite solo laner: Misha tanks while Rexxar soaks for free, bullying Azmodan and Xul; hard divers like Illidan kill him through her.

combos.johanna: Johanna Blessed Shield stuns so your Misha, Charge! and Spirit Swoop chain the lockdown
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost roots the group for your Misha, Charge! and Spirit Swoop to pile on
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them for your Misha, Charge! stun and Spirit Swoop slow

rexxar.trait_tip: Misha, Focus! (trait): send Misha to body-block skillshots, soak abilities, or lock onto a diving assassin; target Rexxar to recall her when she is low.
build_why: Boosts Spirit Swoop against minions, the waveclear and soak that lets Rexxar hold a solo lane.
Misha lifesteals on attacks, keeps your bear alive as a frontline peel wall against dive.
Big slow upgrade on Spirit Swoop, your primary setup to lock a target for Misha and your team.
Massive Misha attack damage for a burst window, your main kill pressure, commit it on a caught target.
Spirit Swoop grants attack speed extended by Misha, ramps your sustained damage in a long fight.
Move speed on your attacks, chase down kites and keep Misha stuck on the target.
Longer Bestial Wrath plus heavy self-heal off Misha, turns your ult window into sustain and survival.

sonya.why: 48.3% wr: classic solo laner, dives well

plan.early: Offlane: Whirlwind through the full wave to heal, Ancient Spear whoever tries to leave. Solo your camp at 5, she takes it fastest.
plan.mid: Wrath of the Berserker at 10: pop it, Spear in, keep swinging so Fury extends it. Use it to shrug slows and stuns, not as a finisher.
plan.fight: Spear their backline only with follow-up; otherwise Whirlwind the frontline and be unkillable. Wrath halves stun and root duration.
plan.late: Late you out-duel anyone and solo bosses. Silences and Tychus melt you mid-Whirlwind, so count their CC before you commit the Spear.

sonya.solo: Top-tier solo bruiser: Whirlwind sustain wins almost every melee matchup; Leoric drains her and blind or kite lanes shut her down.

combos.muradin: Muradin Storm Bolt stuns so your Ancient Spear and Seismic Slam pile onto the held target
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost roots them so your Whirlwind and Seismic Slam grind the frozen clump
combos.medivh: Medivh Portal drops you onto the backline and Force of Will shields your Whirlwind dive
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Bloodlust and Chain Heal fuel your dive so Whirlwind and Seismic Slam stay lethal

build_why: Free empowered Seismic Slam every 4th cast, sustains your Fury economy and boosts your main damage.
Instant Fury plus an empowered attack, burst on demand and fixes Fury starvation when you engage.
Whirlwind heals for more, the self-sustain that lets Sonya dive in and solo camps between fights.
Damage boost and CC reduction, your engage and bruiser steroid, the standard teamfight ult.
Ancient Spear always pulls you in on a lower cooldown, reliable gap-close and escape even on a miss.
Percent-health damage plus heal on attacks and Slam, melts tanks and sustains you against a beefy frontline.
Wrath adds health and an unstoppable button, break CC and survive the focus during your damage window.

thrall.why: 51.4% wr on a big sample: reliable sustain bruiser

plan.early: Feral Spirit the wave then poke with Chain Lightning; Frostwolf Resilience heals every trade. The wolf root starts every gank.
plan.mid: Sundering at 10: split their team on the objective or wall the carry off from the healer, then root and Windfury the stranded half.
plan.fight: Second-wave assassin: let the tank engage, then Windfury onto the CC'd target and wolf-root the peel. Never lead the charge yourself.
plan.late: Late a good Sundering wins the fight alone; keep trait stacks banked before you engage. Kite comps that deny his autos starve him.

thrall.solo: Can offlane vs melee, trait sustain and the wolf root punish hard, but self-sustain bruisers like Johanna and Arthas outlast him.

combos.diablo: Diablo Shadow Charge stuns a target for your Feral Spirit root and Chain Lightning
combos.fenix: Fenix Purification Salvo softens the target you burst with Chain Lightning and Windfury
combos.chromie: Chromie Slowing Sands glues enemies down so your Chain Lightning and Windfury connect
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Earthbind Totem slows a target so your Feral Spirit lands and you stick to it

build_why: Chain Lightning quest ramps its bounce damage, boosts your waveclear and poke throughout the game.
Feral Spirit grants physical armor stacks, timed mitigation that lets Thrall brawl through auto-attackers.
Next attack after an ability hits harder, the core of your burst rotation, weave abilities into attacks.
Your engage and pick ult, a long stun line that shoves and locks a target, sets up wombo or peels divers.
Windfury grants double resilience stacks, heavy armor uptime that makes you tanky while you cleave.
Windfury's final strike triple-hits, a big burst spike on your main damage ability.
Teleport plus Windfury on demand, the mobility and reset to engage, escape, or chase a kill.

varian.note: Flex pick: taunt tank or twin blades carry
varian.why: 50.9% wr: flexible tank or damage, jack of all trades

plan.early: Trade with Lion's Fang and Parry the big auto; your spike is level 4 when the heroic comes online. Shove, then join the first gank.
plan.mid: Pick at 4: Taunt if you must tank, Twin Blades to carry, Smash for burst. On objectives open by Charge-Taunting their key damage.
plan.fight: Charge in, Taunt the carry your team is already hitting, Parry the counter-swing. Taunt also interrupts channels, save it for those.
plan.late: Late Taunt Varian peels and interrupts; Twin Blades must stay on safe targets. You are the CC magnet, so track Parry charges.

varian.solo: Decent solo laner after 4: Twin Blades sustain bullies melee and Parry blanks Butcher; ranged offlaners kite him out before then.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit locks a group so your Charge stun and Colossus Smash pile on
combos.blaze: Blaze Combustion ignites and locks a clump you Charge into and Colossus Smash
combos.liming: Li-Ming Arcane Orb and Magic Missiles finish the target you pin with Charge and Taunt
combos.tyrande: Tyrande Lunar Flare stuns a target for your Charge follow-up and Colossus Smash

build_why: The flex quest: completing it grants your chosen heroic, take it every single game.
The tank path, silence and force-attack plus huge HP, drafts Varian as a frontline anti-carry.
Boosts Lion's Fang healing, your self-sustain to hold the frontline as a taunt tank.
The survival heroic: full immunity on Parry makes you unkillable through their burst.
Percent-health on Charge adds pick potential and tank-busting to your engage.
Team move speed, an engage or disengage tool that amps your whole squad.
Banner now heals too, a team-wide sustain aura on a short cooldown for long fights.

xul.why: 47.6% wr: push machine, weak in fights

plan.early: You are the wave: clear, mount, rotate, clear again while skeletons shove. Bone Armor makes ganks cheap. Never stop soaking.
plan.mid: Skeletal Mages at 10: wall the objective choke so their team enters slowed or gives the point up. Cast it early, not as a save.
plan.fight: Bone Prison their diver, Cursed Strikes to halve every auto-attacker's speed, mages across the choke. You zone, you do not assassinate.
plan.late: Late the push wins: every dead hero means a skeleton lane hitting core. Getting picked first is the risk, use Bone Armor early.

xul.solo: Classic solo laner: out-pushes everyone and Cursed Strikes ruins melee auto-attackers; Johanna's blind and ranged poke keep him passive.

combos.tyrande: Tyrande Lunar Flare stuns a target for your Bone Prison root and Poison Nova
combos.medivh: Medivh Ley Line Seal freezes a group for your Poison Nova and Skeletal Mages to stack
combos.liming: Li-Ming Disintegrate and Arcane Orb melt the clump held by your Bone Prison and Cursed Strikes
combos.falstad: Falstad Mighty Gust knocks enemies together for your Bone Prison and Poison Nova

build_why: Bone Armor's expiry burns nearby heroes for percent-health, free trade damage every skirmish.
Cursed Strikes CDR plus attack damage, spam the cleave to melt waves and poke.
Skeletons refund health and mana, sustaining your endless wave-clear and lane presence.
Massive AoE DoT, the pick versus stacked comps, huge damage that also delays their objective.
Extra scythes on your root mean wider gank setups and more wave-delete.
Your cleave and skeletons cut enemy damage, a team-wide defensive debuff in brawls.
Poison Nova heals you and lasts longer, sustaining you through the fight it zones.

yrel.note: Late-game bully, save allies with E
yrel.why: 56.0% wr this patch (volatile): unkillable with a healer

plan.early: Offlane: charge Vindication on the wave to heal, keep Divine Purpose banked for an instant Righteous Hammer when they jump you.
plan.mid: Sacred Ground at 10: drop it ON the point and dare them to walk in. You cannot be moved off it, so hold until they truly commit.
plan.fight: Front-arc bully: Hammer the diver off your healer, Avenging Wrath stun the clump, charge casts from behind your tank's body.
plan.late: Late she is near unkillable on Sacred Ground; take Ardent Defender into burst. Percent damage and Stukov's silence cancel her charges.

yrel.solo: A-tier solo bruiser: outsustains melee and punishes dives with Divine Purpose stuns; Malthael and ranged percent pressure beat her.

combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball drops a target into your charged Vindication stun
combos.zarya: Zarya Graviton Surge holds a group inside your charged Vindication and Aegis of Wrath
combos.sgthammer: Sgt. Hammer Concussive Blast stuns a target for your charged Aegis of Wrath
combos.whitemane: Whitemane Inquisition roots a target you finish with charged Vindication

yrel.trait_tip: Divine Purpose (trait) to instantly fire a normally-charged Basic Ability at no mana: use it to guarantee a Righteous Hammer stun or an escape when caught.
build_why: Armor on every ability cast, your steady survivability while you charge abilities.
Cleanse plus speed for an ally, the reason she saves people, pull them out of a root or slow.
No slow while channeling Hammer lets you chase down and land your empowered abilities.
Full damage immunity plus heal, the unkillable bubble that flips their all-in.
Spell power stacks on max-charge hits ramp your late-game bully damage.
Armor shred plus percent-health on Hammer, your teamfight burst and tank-buster.
Ardent Defender heals allies too, turning your survival ult into a team save.

thebutcher.note: Feed him meat, one lamb equals one kill
thebutcher.why: 51.5% wr: snowballs off stacks, punishes squishy comps

plan.early: Meat first, kills second: soak and last-hit for Fresh Meat and do not die, deaths cost stacks. Hit 200 before you play hero.
plan.mid: Lamb to the Slaughter at 10: chain it onto Ruthless Onslaught, Brand the target, they die tethered. Flank objectives, never walk in front.
plan.fight: One job: Onslaught the marked squishy with Brand up and kill them inside the Lamb. Brand is your only sustain, never waste it as damage.
plan.late: Late with 200 meat you one-combo squishies; blinds and body-block peel blank you. A CC'd Butcher is a dead Butcher, count their stuns.

thebutcher.solo: Can offlane for stacks against passive laners, but real bruisers like Johanna or Yrel starve him; start ganking once meat is rolling.

combos.abathur: Abathur Symbiote shields and speeds you so Ruthless Onslaught reaches the kill
combos.tyrande: Tyrande Lunar Flare stuns a target for your Ruthless Onslaught charge and cleave
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target still for your Butcher's Brand cleave
combos.tyrael: Tyrael Sanctification bubble lets you sit on the target chained by Lamb to the Slaughter

build_why: Hamstring refunds mana and cooldown on a hero, keeps your slow up to stick to the target and chase kills.
Ruthless Onslaught cooldown drops on impact, back-to-back charges to lock down a fleeing target.
Spell armor on Onslaught impact, eats a burst mage combo as you dive into their backline.
Your pick ult, a post that roots a hero in place, one lamb equals one kill on a caught squishy.
Onslaught adds percent-health damage, makes your engage chunk tanks and bruisers hard.
Attack speed and armor when low, the comeback survivability to finish a fight you dove into hurt.
Attacks slow and hit harder, a built-in stick that guarantees your target cannot escape your damage.

alexstrasza.note: Big fight healing in dragon form

plan.early: Poke with Flame Buffet, drop Abundance behind minions for real trades; Gift of Life costs your own HP, never cast it below half.
plan.mid: Take Life-Binder at 10 for the double heal; open objective fights in Dragonqueen form when they commit and can't disengage.
plan.fight: Stand second line, pre-place Abundance where your team will actually fight, and save Dragonqueen to flip their hard engage.
plan.late: Late, Verdant Flourish keeps you topped for cheap Gift of Life; you lose to anti-heal and dive, never start a fight under 60% HP.

combos.johanna: Johanna's Condemn pulls them into a clump for your Dragonqueen Cleansing Flame to nuke and heal
combos.blaze: Blaze's Jet Propulsion charge stun holds them for your Flame Buffet detonation and Cleansing Flame
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts a clump for your Cleansing Flame dives to land uncontested
combos.azmodan: Azmodan's Globe of Annihilation zoning corners them for your Flame Buffet and Cleansing Flame burst

alexstrasza.trait_tip: Dragonqueen (trait): transform right as a teamfight opens, not after, so the +500 Health and empowered abilities are up for the whole fight.
build_why: Keeps Gift of Life spammable while you stay topped up, your baseline single-target healing engine.
Turns Abundance into a speed boost for engage or disengage, not just raw healing.
Rewards good positioning, the self-heal refunds Gift of Life's cost so your Health never dips.
The clutch swing save, top a low ally instantly and raise your effective pool in a brawl.
Armor exactly when they chain-CC you, your survival answer vs dive that hunts the healer.
Big-fight value, layers shields on Abundance so preemptive heals hold against burst.
Adds real damage in Dragonqueen, your attacks chunk while you heal through the fight.

anduin.note: Pull saves divers, huge clutch ult
anduin.why: 49.0% wr + 23% ban: pull saves, solid all-rounder

plan.early: Poke with Divine Star through the wave for double value; cancel Flash Heal channels you don't need to save mana and cooldown.
plan.mid: Lightbomb at 10; hold it for their dive landing on your backline, one two-man stun wins most objective fights.
plan.fight: Keep Leap of Faith for the hooked or gorged ally, pull the instant CC lands, then Chastise the diver off yourself.
plan.late: Late your Lightwell build out-sustains poke, but you have no escape; stay in Chastise range of your tank and never show side lane.

combos.johanna: Johanna's Condemn clumps them for your Lightbomb stun and Chastise root to chain hard CC
combos.blaze: Blaze's Jet Propulsion stun sets up your Chastise root and Lightbomb on the clump
combos.raynor: Raynor's Penetrating Round knocks a target into your Chastise root and Lightbomb range
combos.diablo: Diablo's Shadow Charge and Overpower pin them for your Lightbomb stun to detonate

anduin.trait_tip: Leap of Faith (trait): yank an ally out of a dive or channel, and use the Unstoppable it grants to pull a chained teammate free of CC.
build_why: Spread Flash Heal across targets for near-free casts, your mana-efficient multi-target sustain.
Gives you real poke and lane presence, Divine Star chips while your attack range extends.
Self-sustain so you heal allies without dropping yourself, keeps you alive under poke.
The clutch teamfight save, mass-heal and Protect your team through a wombo.
Chains Divine Star casts and gives escape speed, keeps your poke-heal loop rolling.
An on-demand giant heal reset for a dived ally, and it comes back faster when you poke.
Upgrades your ult to full Invulnerability, hard-counters their all-in timing.

auriel.note: Needs a damage battery, res wins fights
auriel.why: 52.7% wr: free healing scales with your damage dealers

plan.early: Bestow Hope on your highest-damage laner and bank energy; Detainment Strike into a wall is your kill setup, don't poke with it.
plan.mid: Crystal Aegis at 10; Aegis the ally mid-combo, not after it lands, and never start an objective without a full energy bar.
plan.fight: Your healing IS your team's damage: call fights on, keep Ray of Heaven hitting two allies, stun-peel divers into walls with Q.
plan.late: Late, empty energy means zero healing; if your carry dies, disengage. Aegis the Pyroblast target and reset the fight on your terms.

combos.valla: Valla's sustained Hatred fire builds your Bestow Hope energy for a huge Ray of Heaven burst heal
combos.diablo: Diablo's Shadow Charge knocks a target toward you for a Detainment Strike stun into terrain
combos.chogall: Cho'gall's Runic Blast and Surging Fist damage flood your Bestow Hope energy for a massive Ray of Heaven
combos.yrel: Yrel's Righteous Hammer stun and Sanctification set up your Detainment Strike and a safe Ray of Heaven

auriel.trait_tip: Bestow Hope (trait): attach it to whoever will deal the most Hero damage this fight, since only their damage fills the heal you give back.
build_why: Center-hit Sweeps refund cooldown, your energy-and-poke engine to keep Ray of Heaven flowing.
Ramps Detainment Strike into a real pin, a knockback tool to wall-stun engagers.
Maximizes energy stored from your battery's damage, the core of your healing output.
The fight-winner, bring a dead ally straight back and swing a lost teamfight.
Adds a Blind to Sweep to shut down an auto-attacker, pick vs AA-reliant carries.
