Longer grav that also silences locks their team in for the full wombo.

ltmorales.why: 48.7% wr: single-target lock-on, dies to dive

plan.early: Beam the laner taking hits and let Caduceus Reactor regen you; hold Displacement Grenade for their gap-closer, it cancels engages.
plan.mid: Stim Drone at 10 on your Raynor or Valla at objectives; Medivac only with an organized five. Enter fights above half energy.
plan.fight: Tunnel the focus target with Healing Beam, Safeguard the burst, grenade divers off you; sync your steps so the beam never breaks.
plan.late: Late, Stim on your hypercarry wins fights outright; energy is finite, don't beam chip damage, and never facecheck, you feed picks.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit locks the team while your Healing Beam sustains the follow-up burst
combos.raynor: Raynor Penetrating Round knocks a target back as your Safeguard shield keeps him diving
combos.valla: Valla Strafe melts the group while your Healing Beam keeps her alive through it
combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn holds enemies as your Displacement Grenade and beam back the dive

build_why: Bonus range keeps you out of reach while feeding Energy, so Stim Drone and Safeguard come online faster.
Your anti-dive layer, the armor procs the moment you get focused so you don't get bursted before healing back.
Turns Safeguard into a slow-cleanse on a short cooldown, take it to keep your carry mobile vs slow-heavy comps.
The reason you draft Morales, turns your best auto-attacker into a monster for the fight.
Extra poke that shreds shields, take it vs shield-stacking comps like Zarya or Medivh.
Boosts single-target throughput, your beam target keeps healing while you weave off to safety.
Near double Stim uptime plus more kite speed, one boost for every fight, doubling down on your carry-buffing job.

plan.early: Win the solo lane to stack Sadism: Telekinesis them into Discord Strike's silence, and do not die, deaths bleed your stacks.
plan.mid: Counter-Strike at 10: bait their stun or burst, flip it back for the kill window, then combo Telekinesis into Discord Strike.
plan.fight: Go second: let tanks trade first, then Telekinesis their healer into your team, Discord silences the save, self-cast E to exit.
plan.late: At high Sadism you one-shot squishies; every late death costs stacks, so flank, kill isolated targets, and never coin-flip a fight.

alarak.solo: Premier solo laner: the silence wins trades, Lightning Surge clears while poking, and one kill snowballs Sadism; just respect ganks.

combos.raynor: Raynor's Penetrating Round knocks them back into your Discord Strike and Deadly Charge combo
combos.jaina: Jaina's Ring of Frost roots a clump for your uncontested Discord Strike into Lightning Surge
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit locks a clump still for your Discord Strike and Deadly Charge to shred
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Balls a target into your Telekinesis and Deadly Charge burst range

build_why: Your sustain and dueling spike, the lifesteal and attack speed win every trade after landing Discord.
Quest ramps Discord damage so your combo one-shots squishies by mid game.
Longer Silence locks a mage out of every escape, the whole reason to draft Alarak.
Your gap-closer and fight opener, engage from off-screen and stack Sadism on their backline.
Snowball tool, mark their carry to pump Sadism every Discord and reach terrifying damage.
Doubles your poke and burst, a second free Surge on another target to zone or finish.
Escape plus reposition, teleport out of a lost dive or into a cleaner Discord angle.

plan.early: Stack Globe of Annihilation on full waves, ping so team leaves you the wave; send Demon Lieutenant to empty lanes on cooldown.
plan.mid: At 10 take Demonic Invasion: drop it on a fort while your team stalls the objective, trading siege for their attention.
plan.fight: Open with max-range Globe on clumps, channel All Shall Burn only behind your front; cancel it the second a stun threatens.
plan.late: Late you win via a 200+ stack Globe and constant three-lane push; you lose if stunned mid-channel, so track their CC.

azmodan.solo: Strong solo laner: wins the sustained wave war while stacking Globe, but hard dive punishes his total lack of escape.

combos.jaina: Jaina's Ring of Frost roots a clump dead-on for your Globe of Annihilation to detonate for huge damage
combos.johanna: Johanna's Condemn pulls them into one spot for your Globe of Annihilation and All Shall Burn channel
combos.malfurion: Malfurion's Entangling Roots pins a target so you channel All Shall Burn uninterrupted to melt them
combos.maiev: Maiev's Containment Disc suspends a hero for a guaranteed Globe of Annihilation to the face

azmodan.trait_tip: Demon Lieutenant (trait): drop it on a beefy minion or demon to keep a lane pushing while you fight elsewhere.
build_why: Ramps your global range and Globe damage, the quest that makes you a screen-away sieger.
Extra Demon Warrior for stronger lane pressure and constant split-push threat.
Weaves attacks after Globe for extra burst, spiking your single-target damage.
Wave of grunts for burst plus push, your camp-soak and fight-damage ult.
Beefier, slowing demons that peel for you and pressure lanes harder.
Adds percent-max-HP to Globe, turning poke into real burst on tanks and squishies alike.
Your demons melt structures, the macro finisher that closes out games.

plan.early: Fend the wave, keep moving so Avoidance armor stays up, and throw Lightning Fury through gates to stack Thunderstroke.
plan.mid: At 10 take Ball Lightning: bounce it between two stunned targets at objectives, then Fend through the leftovers.
plan.fight: Your job is deleting their auto-attackers: Blinding Light the Valla or Raynor, then Fend blinded targets for bonus damage.
plan.late: Late, Infinite Lightning bounces win extended fights; stay stutter-stepping, standing still drops Avoidance and you melt.

cassia.solo: Can offlane into auto-attack bruisers thanks to Avoidance and Blind, but loses to mages and heavy CC; a niche counterpick.

combos.lili: Lili's Water Dragon slow holds them in place for your Fend spin and Lightning Fury to melt
combos.johanna: Johanna's Condemn clumps them tight for your Fend channel and Lightning Fury bounces to shred
combos.artanis: Artanis Phase Prism pulls a target next to you for a point-blank Fend and Valkyrie pull
combos.jaina: Jaina's Ring of Frost roots the clump for your uninterrupted Fend and Ball Lightning barrage

build_why: Ramps Lightning Fury damage per Hero hit, your scaling poke and waveclear quest.
Self-heal tied to hitting Fury, sustains you through lane and poke wars.
Punishes auto-attackers into your Avoidance, turning their AA into your burst counter.
Bounces huge damage in a clumped fight, your teamfight nuke when they group up.
Protected during Fend lets you channel your damage safely into a brawl.
Piercing Fury marks enemies for a burst spike, ramping your sustained AoE threat.
Long Blind on your impale target shuts off an enemy carry's whole auto-attack window.

chromie.note: Longest range in the game, punish immobile comps
chromie.why: 50.9% wr: long-range poke, punishes immobile comps

plan.early: Poke Sand Blast on cooldown from max range and finish Timewalker's Pursuit; you outrange everyone, never take return fire.
plan.mid: At her early 10 take Slowing Sands: drop it on the objective choke and Dragon's Breath anyone who sits in the slow.
plan.fight: Sit two screens back, spam Sand Blast into their frontline, and save Time Trap for the Zeratul or Tracer coming for you.
plan.late: Late you outrange keeps and win every poke war, but one dive kills you; never move without a Time Trap planted behind you.

combos.malfurion: Malfurion's Entangling Roots pins a target dead still for your Sand Blast and Dragon's Breath to land
combos.ana: Ana's Sleep Dart freezes a target for a guaranteed Sand Blast and Dragon's Breath combo
combos.johanna: Johanna's Condemn clumps them so your Dragon's Breath and Sand Blast hit the whole group
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds a clump still for your Dragon's Breath and Sand Blast to detonate for free

chromie.trait_tip: Detonate Time Trap (trait): manually trigger your planted trap to Stun the instant you land Sand Blast, instead of waiting for them to step on it.
build_why: Ramps Dragon's Breath into a real waveclear and AoE nuke; take when they clump so you land hits and finish the quest fast.
Three Time Traps let you wall off multiple angles and guarantee Sand Blast follow-ups; the core trap-control pick.
Adds a slow to Dragon's Breath so you self-peel and land guaranteed Sand Blasts on anyone caught in the center.
A lockdown zone to trap immobile targets and guarantee your poke lands; plays directly to punishing rooted comps.
Your repositioning escape; swap to an Echo to dodge dives and keep max range on comps that can't reach you.
A burst window that turns poke into a one-shot; landing Sand Blast keeps it near-permanent uptime.
Turns Slowing Sands into a spell-armor shred zone so your whole team's magic burst amplifies on trapped enemies.

falstad.why: 51.8% wr + 29% ban: global value on every big map

plan.early: Trade with Hammerang plus autos, keep Barrel Roll pocketed, and use Flight to double-soak the moment your wave is safe.
plan.mid: At 10 take Mighty Gust: fly cross-map to arrive first at objectives, then Gust their team off the point or into yours.
plan.fight: Stutter-step their frontline, hook Lightning Rod on whoever stays in range, and hold Gust to cancel a Mosh or peel divers.
plan.late: Late, Flight lets you soak and still make every fight; dying to stealth ganks mid-rotation is how you throw it.

falstad.solo: Not a true solo laner, but Flight covers the solo lane in a pinch and punishes offlaners who overextend without vision.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit stun-locks their team while you free-cast Hammerang and Lightning Rod
combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows them so your Hammerang and Lightning Rod never miss
combos.tassadar: Tassadar Force Wall traps them in place for uncontested Lightning Rod damage
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target for your point-blank Barrel Roll and Hammerang

build_why: Ramps Hammerang into heavy poke and waveclear; the scaling pick that rewards landing your skillshot.
Lightning Rod grants a stacking shield; free survivability while you sit and auto-attack in fights.
Longer Hammerang plus big attack bonus while it's out; your core auto-attack DPS spike.
Long-range execute nuke with a huge CD refund on hits; snipe low targets and poke from total safety.
Tailwind doubles ability recharge; nonstop Hammerang and Barrel Roll uptime while you rotate the map.
Faster, stronger Tailwind; more sustained move speed to auto-kite and rotate between lanes quicker.
Double-range, higher-damage Hinterland Blast; a map-wide execute that finishes fights from screens away.

fenix.note: Shield resets, shreds tanks at range

plan.early: Swap weapons smartly: Repeater Cannon for trades, Phase Bomb for wave; poke Plasma Cutter plus autos while shields eat free.
plan.mid: At 10 take Purification Salvo: tag the two squishiest heroes at objectives, then Repeater Cannon them as the salvo lands.
plan.fight: Max-range stutter-step with Repeater Cannon, Plasma Cutter their retreat path, and Warp out the moment your shield breaks.
plan.late: Late, Offensive Cadence third shots win DPS races; Warp's delay is your risk, start it before they land on you, not after.

fenix.solo: Can hold a solo lane briefly on shields and waveclear, but zero sustain means he bleeds health; better in a duo lane.

combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn pulls them together for your channeled Planetcracker Cannon beam
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc holds a hero still while you unload Repeater Cannon and Phase Bomb
combos.thrall: Thrall Sundering stuns their line into your Planetcracker beam sweep
combos.diablo: Diablo Apocalypse stuns the whole team for your Planetcracker Cannon channel

build_why: Bonus attack damage after moving; rewards your kiting so you keep poking between repositions.
Attacks on slowed heroes stack move speed; keeps you glued to kited targets and safe while dealing damage.
Plasma Cutter hits slowed targets harder; your burst combo right after you land the slow.
A battleground-wide beam for massive sustained teamfight and wave damage; the standard high-output heroic.
Trades Health for a huge shield that regens off attacks; the survivability engine to brawl at the front.
Every 3rd attack deals percent-max Health; the reason Fenix melts tanks, scales your DPS vs beefy targets.
Doubles Repeater Cannon attack speed; your late-game DPS explosion that shreds anything you focus.

gall.note: Other half of Cho, duo only

plan.early: You are the damage half: Shadowflame every wave Cho walks into, bounce Dread Orb behind minions for poke. Farm to 13, do not force.
plan.mid: Twisting Nether at 10: call it when Cho is deep and they clump, the slow plus detonation zones the whole objective by itself.
plan.fight: Your job is uptime: Shadowflame on cooldown, catch the Dread Orb bounce-back, and call targets. You steer the damage, Cho steers the feet.
plan.late: Late, two heads scale hardest in the game and 2v5 fights at 16 plus. Cocoon or Containment Disc deletes both of you, track Maiev.

combos.chogall: Cho'gall Surging Fist stuns and knocks enemies into your Dread Orb and Shadowflame
combos.ana: Ana Sleep Dart pins a hero so your slow Dread Orbs and Runic Blast land clean
combos.auriel: Auriel Detainment Strike stuns them into a wall for your Shadow Bolt Volley
combos.brightwing: Brightwing Emerald Wind pushes them into your Dread Orb bounce path

gall.trait_tip: Ogre Rage (trait): toggle on for 25% more damage when going for a kill, but leave it off while Cho tanks so his Armor stays up.
build_why: Better Shove speed and duration off Cho's movement; helps the shared body reposition and kite in fights.
Dread Orb ramps radius and damage and can reverse; your main poke, controllable AoE that punishes clumps.
Stacking Shadowflame damage on the same target; rewards sustained focus for real single-target burst.
Aim-controlled barrage for enormous teamfight damage; the standard high-output heroic.
Shadowflame adds percent-max Health damage; scales your poke against high-Health frontlines.
Basic abilities stack a slow; self-peel and lockdown to hold enemies in your damage since Cho drives movement.
Takedowns permanently ramp Ogre Rage; snowballs your damage the longer the game and the more kills you get.

genji.why: 48.3% wr: needs coordination solo queue rarely gives

plan.early: Poke with Shuriken fans, tax the wave, and keep Swift Strike as your exit; dying early on Genji is the only way to lose the lane.
plan.mid: X-Strike at 10: land it on a CC'd target after your tank's stun and Swift Strike through so both cross-slashes connect.
plan.fight: Hunt the lowest target: a Swift Strike kill resets the dash, Deflect their answer on the way in, Cyber Agility over the wall out.
plan.late: Late your resets snowball cleanups; the risks are mana and CC, so keep 25% mana, never dive without Deflect, exit before the stun.

combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes their team for your Dragonblade dives and X-Strike
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target so your Swift Strike and Shuriken finish it
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit stun-locks them while you reset Dragonblade on kills
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts them helpless into your Dragonblade and X-Strike

genji.trait_tip: Cyber Agility (trait): save the leap to dodge a key skillshot or reposition mid Swift Strike combo, not just to travel.
build_why: Swift Strike grants move speed on hero hits; keeps you slippery to weave in and out of their backline.
Quest ramps Shuriken damage and cuts Cyber Agility CD; your core scaling for both burst and mobility.
Deflect converts blocked damage into a shield; rewards a good deflect with the survivability to dive again.
A delayed cross burst that combos with Swift Strike resets; the high-burst pick to delete a squishy.
Hitting all 3 Shuriken adds big bonus damage; your primary damage spike for landing full combos.
Swift Strike stacks damage per hero hit; rewards diving into their clump with escalating burst.
Dragonblade extends on hits and refreshes Swift Strike on kills; turns a fed ult into a backline massacre.

greymane.note: Highest sustained damage in the game

plan.early: Bounce Gilnean Cocktail off the wave so the cone burns their hero, stay Human at range, and only go Worgen once their CC is down.
plan.mid: Cursed Bullet at 10: fire it into the tank or a fat healer right after your team engages, then Darkflight in and finish in Worgen.
plan.fight: Poke in Human until someone hits half, then all-in: Razor Swipe through them, Worgen autos, and Swipe back out when peel arrives.
plan.late: Late you execute anyone below half: wait out the healer's cooldowns before the all-in; overstaying in Worgen into CC kills you.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit stun-locks their backline for your Worgen dive and Go for the Throat
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Balls a carry to you for point-blank Cocktail and Worgen burst
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target so your Cocktail combo executes it
combos.malthael: Malthael Reaper's Mark and slow lock a target for your Go for the Throat leaps

build_why: Bigger Inner Beast CD reduction per attack; keeps your Worgen burst windows up far more often.
Attacks restore mana and cut Healing Fountain CD; solves your mana and adds map sustain for aggressive play.
Longer Human attack range; lets you poke and Cocktail safely before committing to a Worgen dive.
A leap execute that can chain on kills; the pick to dive and reset through their backline.
Longer, lower-CD Darkflight and Disengage; more dive range in and safety out, your mobility spike.
Worgen attacks add percent-max Health damage; the reason you shred tanks, scales your sustained DPS.
Go for the Throat hits harder and fully resets on kills; snowball a teamfight into a solo wipe.

plan.early: Life Tap freely then Fel Flame the wave; you never leave lane for mana, just don't Tap below half with their ganker missing.
plan.mid: At 10 take Horrify: at objectives fear their frontline off your carries, or flip a dive the second they jump your backline.
plan.fight: Corruption the clump, Drain Life whoever your tank roots, and keep Healthstone for the burst window right after a Life Tap.
plan.late: Late, Haunt plus Darkness Within makes you a raid boss; mobile assassins are the loss condition, hug peel and pre-aim Horrify.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit stun-locks their team while you free-cast Corruption and Drain Life
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them in your Corruption pools and Fel Flame
combos.auriel: Auriel Detainment Strike stuns them into a wall for stacked Corruption ticks
combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn pulls their team into your Corruption and Rain of Destruction

guldan.trait_tip: Life Tap (trait): spend Health for 25% Mana only when safe; tapping low in a fight can leave you too fragile to survive their combo.
build_why: Widens Fel Flame; the standard scaling pick since Fel Flame is your bread-and-butter poke and sustain fuel.
More mana per Life Tap; keeps your no-cooldown spam online so you never run dry mid-fight.
Drain Life adds damage and a heavy slow; self-peel plus a lockdown to hold targets in your damage.
Your fight-flipper: an AoE fear and silence that breaks their engage and sets up your team's follow-up.
Spell armor on Fel Flame hits; the survivability vs burst mages so you can stand and channel damage.
A free Life Tap plus a spell-power burst after damage; your damage spike that rewards landing spells.
Longer Horrify plus armor shred on feared enemies; turns your CC ult into a team-wide damage-amp wombo.

hanzo.note: Poke them out before the fight starts
hanzo.why: 50.8% wr: poke + waveclear, up this patch

plan.early: Storm Bow pokes at max range for Target Practice stacks; Sonic Arrow every bush before you step up, never facecheck.
plan.mid: At 10 take Dragon's Arrow: fire from mid range so the stun lands, then full Storm Bow charge plus Scatter on the stunned target.
plan.fight: Live at max bow range, ricochet Scatter Arrow off walls into melee, and keep Natural Agility strictly as your escape.
plan.late: Late, Bullseye stuns turn picks into won fights; divers are your risk, hop terrain early, not after they land on you.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit clusters their team for your Scatter Arrow ricochets and Dragonstrike
combos.diablo: Diablo Apocalypse stuns them together for your Scatter Arrow and Dragonstrike channel
combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn pulls their team into a wall for your Scatter Arrow bounce burst
combos.malganis: Mal'Ganis Carrion Swarm sleeps their group for your Dragonstrike and Scatter Arrow

hanzo.trait_tip: Natural Agility (trait): jump over walls or structures to escape a dive, chase a kill, or take a surprise angle; it's your only escape, so don't waste it.
build_why: Free scaling for tagging all 5 once, do it early and your poke range balloons for the rest of the game.
Turns Storm Bow into instant waveclear so you can shove and roam, take it on maps that reward soak.
Autos refund Scatter's cooldown, keeping your bounce-shot pick tool up far more often in skirmish-heavy games.
Your teamfight zoning ult, drop it on the objective or a clumped enemy to force them off with huge sustained AoE.
Stacks move speed off Storm Bow hits, take it to kite dive and hold spacing while you keep poking.
The damage spike: Storm Bow and Scatter pierce, doubling waveclear and letting one arrow tag a whole line.
A second reposition charge, take it when they can dive you so you always keep an out after committing.

illidan.note: Needs enablers and a blind-free enemy comp
illidan.why: 57.3% wr two patches running: sustain meta suits him, feed him a healer

plan.early: Auto everything: Betrayer's Thirst heals you and cuts cooldowns; take camps early, Dive behind for trades, Sweep out before CC.
plan.mid: The Hunt at 10: hold it to cross the map for a pick or to join the fight your team starts; open on the healer, never the tank.
plan.fight: Dive the backline with The Hunt, Evasion when autos focus you, Sweep through targets to dodge skillshots, kite back through your team.
plan.late: Late you live on tempo: split-push, force rotations, and only all-in when their stuns are down; one held Uther stun ends your run.

illidan.solo: Strong solo lane into auto-attackers thanks to Evasion; loses to blinds and sustained-CC bruisers, so ask for a swap versus Arthas.

combos.abathur: Abathur Symbiote shields and spikes you while you dive and never stop hitting
combos.medivh: Medivh Force of Will shields your dive so you free-hit through their focus fire
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Earthbind Totem roots a target for your Sweeping Strike and The Hunt
combos.zarya: Zarya Graviton Surge pulls their team into your Sweeping Strike sustain and The Hunt

build_why: Lifesteal-fueled burn gives the lane sustain and waveclear to keep diving without a healer babysitting you.
Physical armor on Dive, take vs auto-attack comps so you survive the moment you land on their backline.
Move speed and a cd refund on Dive into heroes, your reset to chain-dive and stick to a fleeing target.
Your global engage and stun, flank from across the map to lock their carry and start the fight on your terms.
Armor each time Sweeping Strike tags a hero, the in-fight survivability so you bruise instead of getting bursted.
The damage spike: hit 5 heroes with sweep and your autos hit like a truck, wins extended brawls.
Permanent meta for attack speed and 50% CC reduction, the late answer to being kited and locked down.

jaina.note: Chill slows are soft CC everywhere

plan.early: One Blizzard clears the caster wave; poke Frostbolt into Ice Lance combos and keep Cone of Cold for anyone who jumps you.
plan.mid: At 10 take Water Elemental: open objective fights with Elemental plus Blizzard on the clump for chained Frostbite slows.
plan.fight: Hold Ring of Frost for their dive, chain Cone of Cold slows so melee never reach you, burst the rooted target with Ice Lance.
plan.late: Late your combo one-shots squishies, but you are the squishiest thing alive; play behind two bodies and pre-cast on chokes.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit stun-locks their team for your Ring of Frost and Blizzard combo
combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn pulls them together for your Ring of Frost and Blizzard drop
combos.muradin: Muradin Stormbolt stuns a target so your Frostbolt and Blizzard shatter it
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them for your Ring of Frost and Blizzard

build_why: More Frostbolt reach and speed so you land the Chill from safer range, the setup for every combo you throw.
Frostbolt pierces two, so you clear waves and Chill a whole clump at once for follow-up Blizzard damage.
Frostbolt on a Chilled target refunds cd and mana, the engine that lets you machine-gun spells at frozen enemies.
Your zoning ult and combo finisher, root a clump then dump Blizzard on top, take it when they group.
Bigger, longer-range Blizzard, cast it from safety and blanket more of the fight to keep everyone Chilled.
The burst spike, later Blizzard waves hit far harder, turning your zone into real kill pressure on a clump.
Ring freezes twice, extending your lockdown and letting a single ult set up a full wombo.

plan.early: Lob Frag Launcher at the front edge of their hitbox so grenades bounce in; trap the bush, keep Concussion Mine for escapes.
plan.mid: At 10 take RIP-Tire: drive it in from fog at objectives to split their team, then spam frags into the choke they retreat through.
plan.fight: Shell the clump from behind your tank, pre-place Steel Trap on the flank route, and mine divers off your healer, not for damage.
plan.late: Late you zone entire chokes and Total Mayhem trades even in death; mobile assassins are still your death sentence, hug peel.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit stuns the whole team for your uncontested RIP-Tire detonation
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball tosses enemies together for your Frag Launcher and Concussion Mine spread
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target long enough for your Steel Trap or Tire hit
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a target for your Concussion Mine knockback combo

build_why: Beefs up your last grenade and keeps nades live longer, more zone and burst out of one Frag reload.
The damage quest, stack it early by tagging heroes with Frags so your whole kit scales into midgame.
Concussion Mine slows on landing, so the enemy you boop stays put for your Frags and your team's follow-up.
Your pick and zone ult, drive it around a corner to blow up a squishy or force them off an objective.
Auto then Frag deals bonus damage at extra range, smoothing your in-lane trades and poke DPS.
Hero hits refund Frag's cooldown, the sustained-damage spike that lets you never stop lobbing in a fight.
Bigger grenade and splash radius, take it for consistency so you stop clipping the small hitboxes you chase.

kaelthas.note: Chain bomb wombo with any root
kaelthas.why: 45.5% wr: burst mages are down across the board

plan.early: Verdant Spheres Living Bomb one-shots the caster wave and feeds Mana Addict; Gravity Lapse anyone who walks at you.
plan.mid: At 10 take Phoenix: land it on the objective so it zones and sieges, and save Verdant Spheres for the follow-up Flamestrike.
plan.fight: Spread Living Bomb into their clump, empowered Flamestrike the stunned target; hold Lapse for the diver, it is your only peel.
plan.late: Late an empowered bomb chain wipes teams; you die in one rotation though, so cast from fog and never lead the walk-up.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit locks the team in place for your uncontested Pyroblast and Flamestrike
combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows them into your guaranteed Flamestrike and Living Bomb
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a target for your Pyroblast and Living Bomb chain
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target dead-on for your Pyroblast

kaelthas.trait_tip: Verdant Spheres (trait): spend your sphere on the ability you want empowered this cast; save one for a guaranteed Living Bomb or Flamestrike when it matters.
build_why: A flat spell-power bump and a heal each rotation, free scaling and the sustain to keep poking without a healer.
Longer Gravity Lapse with a mana refund, your setup lift, land it and the whole combo lands for free.
Flamestrike adds max-health damage when it catches two, the reason it hits like a truck into grouped fights.
Sustained AoE that zones and chunks a clump for 7 seconds, the ult that beats Pyroblast when they fight together.
Wider Living Bomb spread, so your bombs chain across a stack and multiply the AoE off one cast.
Flamestrike detonates twice, doubling your burst, the spike that turns a rooted target into a corpse.
Phoenix lasts twice as long and you steer it, turning your ult into a persistent zone that reshapes the fight.

kelthuzad.why: 50.8% wr: chain combo one-shots, high skill

plan.early: Every Chains hit on a hero builds Master of the Cold Dark; fish combos in lane, finishing the quest early is your whole game.
plan.mid: At 10 take Frost Blast: Chains a target, root the clump, then land the full combo and Death and Decay on the frozen pile.
plan.fight: One combo decides it: Chains the frontliner to a wall, Frost Nova the pair, then recast Chains through Glacial Spike.
plan.late: Late with quest done you one-combo squishies; you have zero escapes, so combo from range and keep a body between you and dives.

combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows them into your Chains of Kel'Thuzad root combo
combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn pulls enemies in for your Chains and Frost Nova detonation
combos.anduin: Anduin Chastise roots a target for your Chains hook and Frost Nova burst

build_why: Loads damage and armor shred onto Chains, the pull that starts every combo now hits and softens the target.
Permanent stacking shield each time you land Chains, the survivability that keeps your squishy mage comboing.
Death and Decay ramps the longer they sit in it, the core of his damage, punishing anyone rooted in your zone.
Your delete button, a rooted-target nuke that with a clean Chains-Nova setup one-shots their carry.
Beefier Frost Nova slow that refunds its own cd on damage, the CC engine that locks targets for the combo.
D&D explosions cut their own cooldown, keeping your damage zone up nearly constantly in a drawn-out fight.
A shade doubles your Death and Decay, stacking two damage pools for absurd teamfight and zone output.

kerrigan.why: 57.2% wr: combo one-shots squishies, snowballs hard

plan.early: Stack your level 1 Ravage quest on minions; when they step up, Primal Grasp into Impaling Blades. Assimilation shields win the trade.
plan.mid: Summon Ultralisk at 10: send it as engage or as a peel wall, then run the Grasp into Blades into Ravage combo while it tanks.
plan.fight: You are the pick: Grasp their squishy into the Blades stun and let the team follow. Combo, then let Assimilation shields eat the poke.
plan.late: Late the full combo one-shots; whiffing Grasp is the risk since it is her whole engage. Hold it until their dodge cooldowns are down.

kerrigan.solo: Rarely solos: the combo needs kill follow-up and she starves alone; only offlane her into immobile melee as a cheese pick.

combos.tyrael: Tyrael Sanctification zones them so your Impaling Blades and Ravage land clean
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target into your Impaling Blades combo
combos.medivh: Medivh Force of Will shields your dive so your Ravage and Impaling Blades connect
combos.tyrande: Tyrande Lunar Flare stuns a target for your Impaling Blades follow-up

build_why: Ravage grants shields on hit, the survivability that lets her dive in, combo, and come back out alive.
Ravage's damage quest, farm the early stacks so your engage combo actually kills instead of just poking.
Cuts Ravage's cooldown and doubles PvE damage, better waveclear and a faster reset to reach the backline.
AoE nuke that caps her pull combo, drop it after Impaling Blades to melt everyone you lassoed together.
More shields per damage dealt, take it to be the tankier all-in threat when you're the one starting fights.
Impaled targets take bonus damage from your next hits, the spike that guarantees the pull becomes a kill.
Maelstrom extends each time it damages a hero, turning a clumped fight into a long self-sustaining AoE grind.

liming.why: 51.8% wr on a big sample: resets snowball teamfights

plan.early: Magic Missiles on cooldown, hero hits refund mana with Charged Blast; throw Arcane Orb only at max range where it hurts.
plan.mid: At 10 take Wave of Force into dive or channel comps; fish for one objective kill, the reset refreshes everything, re-engage.
plan.fight: Third line, max range: Orb the clump, Missiles the low target, Teleport aggressively ONLY when the reset kill is guaranteed.
plan.late: Late every reset chains another kill and Tal Rasha ramps; overchasing after one Teleport is how you hand the fight back.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds the team for your uncontested Magic Missiles and Arcane Orb
combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn clusters enemies for your Arcane Orb and Disintegrate line
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a target for your Magic Missiles and Orb combo
combos.varian: Varian Taunt locks a target for your Disintegrate beam and Arcane Orb

liming.trait_tip: Critical Mass (trait): don't hold your combo; a takedown refunds every cooldown, so commit fully to a dive and chain onto the next target.
build_why: Spell armor whenever your missiles connect, the buffer that keeps a zero-defense mage alive through burst.
Arcane Orb refunds cd and mana on a hero hit, your sustainable poke and waveclear from max range.
Third Magic Missile on one target adds big burst, rewarding you for locking your poke onto a single squishy.
A knockback that self-peels and disengages, take it over Disintegrate when their dive would otherwise delete you.
A kill already resets Teleport; this resets it when you take burst too, your extra get-out-of-jail button.
Teleport hands you a shield, stacking with the reset so every blink is also a survival cooldown.
Massively longer Wave of Force range and knockback, turning your peel into a fight-wide displacement tool.

lunara.why: 49.2% wr: poison pressure, hard to catch

plan.early: Poison autos then hop back and let Nature's Toxin tick; Noxious Blossom the wave, never burn Leaping Strike to engage.
plan.mid: At 10 take Thornwood Vine: weave the three-hit vines through objective fights to keep toxin rolling on their whole team.
plan.fight: Kite at max range, keep poison ticking on every enemy the healer must save, save Leaping Strike for the Butcher on you.
plan.late: Late your dot pressure breaks single-target healers; AoE-cleanse healers blank you, so spread toxin wider, not deeper.

lunara.solo: Real offlane option: outranges melee bruisers, poisons and skips away, but a gank with Leaping Strike down usually kills her.

combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows them so your Nature's Toxin and Crippling Spores stack up
combos.muradin: Muradin Haymaker or Stormbolt stuns a target for your Thornwood Vine poke
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost holds them for your Crippling Spores and Thornwood Vine

build_why: Free map vision from your Wisp, the safe default to scout objectives and ganks without risking yourself.
Ramps your poison from range, faster toxin stacking means faster DPS and better zoning of a clump.
Big multi-target hit that spreads Nature's Toxin across their whole team, huge wave clear too.
Long-range burst that banks charges, the damage ult when you want to out-poke rather than control fights.
Your survival pick vs burst mages, eats their key ability so you keep dancing at range.
Your DPS spike once poison is stacked, take it to melt tanks with sustained auto-attacks.
Turns your ult into a poison applicator and extends range and vision, ramping late-game poison pressure.

mephisto.note: Skull spam then global execute ult

plan.early: Lightning Nova the wave then walk it onto their melee; every hero hit refunds cooldowns, so you win trades by circling.
plan.mid: At 10 take Durance of Hate: at objectives Shade in, Nova the clump, and throw Skull Missile as you snap back to safety.
plan.fight: Shade behind them, spin Lightning Nova through max targets, and aim Durance at slowed or rooted heroes so it cannot miss.
plan.late: Late, Nova with full CDR is a fight-long AoE; the snapback spot is your life, never cast Shade from a losing position.

combos.deckard: Deckard Stay Awhile and Listen sleeps them so your Lightning Nova and Durance of Hate melt the group
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit pins a clump for your ramping Lightning Nova and Durance of Hate silence
combos.zarya: Zarya Graviton Surge vortexes them together for your Lightning Nova to ramp and Durance of Hate to lock
combos.diablo: Diablo Apocalypse stuns the whole team so your Lightning Nova ramps and Durance of Hate holds them

build_why: Your damage ramp, the spell power while shading powers your skull spam and rotations.
Free sustain and mana off your main poke, spam skulls to stay on the map without recalling.
Survivability when you dive in with Shade, the armor covers you while you reposition out.
Map-wide execute, finish low targets anywhere and turn any won skirmish into a teamwipe.
Doubles down on skull spam, ramps your poke and adds execute damage on low targets.
Adds burst when you dive a clump with Nova, punishes them for grouping near you.
Turns your ult into a true global execute that can cast twice, wins fights outright when they're low.

nazeebo.why: 43.2% wr, second worst in the game

plan.early: Every minion killed by an ability stacks Voodoo Ritual; Spiders plus Blossom each wave, hit big stacks early or fall off.
plan.mid: At 10 take Gargantuan: drop it at objectives for the stomp slow, and trap their bruiser in Zombie Wall for your team.
plan.fight: Wall the diver off your healer or wall their tank in, Blossom plus Spiders inside it, and keep Ice Block for when they turn.
plan.late: Late, Vile Infection makes toxin lethal; if the quest is not done you are a minion, so soak waves relentlessly all game.

nazeebo.solo: Passable solo laner on big maps: safe ranged clear while stacking Ritual, but loses hard to dive bruisers before Ice Block.

combos.johanna: Johanna Blessed Shield engages so your Zombie Wall traps them for Ravenous Spirit
combos.raynor: Raynor Penetrating Round knocks them into your Zombie Wall and Ravenous Spirit channel
combos.stukov: Stukov Lurking Arm silences a clump so your Zombie Wall and Ravenous Spirit finish them
combos.diablo: Diablo Shadow Charge pins a target to a wall for your Zombie Wall and Ravenous Spirit

build_why: Sticky spiders for kiting, and the attack quest ramps your spider DPS all game.
More health and mana from stacks, stays tanky and topped so you can stack safely into late game.
More spiders means more stacks and DPS, accelerates your ramp toward the 175 quest.
A beefy AoE bruiser summon, zone objectives and add sustained damage plus a stun with the upgrade.
Spell armor plus a spider on your attacker, take it when melee assassins try to blow you up.
Turns spider uptime into ability spam, floods the fight with zombies and spiders for huge AoE.
The payoff for stacking all game, Voodoo Ritual becomes a hero-melting DoT, your late-game monster spike.

plan.early: Gank, don't lane: Pinning Shot into Snipe from cloak on overextended squishies; Holo Decoy baits abilities before you commit.
plan.mid: At 10 take Precision Strike: snipe objective fights from fog, and use it globally to clear far catapult waves between fights.
plan.fight: You are a finisher, not an opener: wait for CC, Pinning Shot into Snipe on the 60 percent target, recloak, reposition, repeat.
plan.late: Late, Rewind doubles your burst combo; if their tank buys reveal or Zarya bubbles your target, swap marks fast or go siege.

combos.johanna: Johanna Blessed Shield stuns so your Triple Tap and Snipe land clean on the target
combos.blaze: Blaze Combustion slows them to a crawl so your Triple Tap and Snipe connect uninterrupted
combos.sylvanas: Sylvanas Wailing Arrow silences a clump so your Precision Strike and Triple Tap land free
combos.stukov: Stukov Massive Shove pins them to terrain for a guaranteed Triple Tap and Snipe

nova.trait_tip: Permanent Cloak (trait): stand still 1.5s to upgrade your stealth to Invisible before crossing enemy vision, so you approach a target unrevealed.
build_why: More range to open safely, land your slow-and-snipe from max distance before they can react.
Free merc camps from your soak, snowball map pressure while you wait for a pick.
Rewards landing snipes, near-spammable poke that chunks their squishies from safety.
Your long-range one-shot combo, delete a squishy from across the fight without leaving stealth.
Two slows to chain a target down, lock your victim so the combo lands and they can't escape.
Amps your whole combo by 20%, take it to guarantee the kill on a tankier target.
Chain-executes, land a kill and immediately snipe the next, can carry a won fight into a wipe.

plan.early: Chomp the wave for safe clear, poke Shadow Waltz from range, and bank Chaos stacks; the dash is your escape, not damage.
plan.mid: At 10 take Eternal Feast: land it on two-plus heroes at objectives and keep dealing damage so it re-triggers through the fight.
plan.fight: Aim Dread slightly behind slowed targets so wave and eruption both hit, then dump Chaos autos; Waltz backward out of dives.
plan.late: Late, Dead Magic turns your autos into AoE burst; hold Waltz for their engage every time, cooldown greed is how you die.

combos.blaze: Blaze Combustion slows the clump so your Chomp and Eternal Feast hit the whole group
combos.johanna: Johanna Condemn pulls them in for your Chomp and Eternal Feast to land on the stack
combos.varian: Varian Taunt locks a target in place for your Shadow Waltz and Chomp burst
combos.malganis: Mal'Ganis Carrion Swarm zones them together for your Crushing Jaws pull and Eternal Feast

orphea.trait_tip: Overflowing Chaos (trait): land a Basic Ability then immediately weave a Basic Attack to spend Chaos for bonus damage; don't let stacks sit or expire unused.
build_why: Rewards comboing off CC, hits harder on locked targets and your own slow enables the follow-up.
Near-spammable dash for poke and mobility, weave in damage and reposition constantly.
Your burst ramp, complete it and land free full-damage Dread eruptions for massive poke.
Your wombo ult, pull their clump together for your team's follow-up or to peel a dive.
Self-peel and sustain in one, punish melee that dive you and heal back while gaining Chaos.
A second Chomp for burst and slow, extends your combo range to catch fleeing targets.
Turns your zone ult into a rotation engine, spam abilities during Feast for relentless burst.

probius.note: Zone control, protect the little guy
probius.why: below the games threshold entirely: niche zone mage

plan.early: Pylon in the bush, Warp Rift under the wave, pop it with Disruption Pulse; you win every clear war if pylons survive.
plan.mid: At 10 take Pylon Overcharge: pre-build pylons at the objective choke and force them to fight inside your cannon field.
plan.fight: Fight inside your power field: chain Warp Rifts in the choke, detonate with Pulse as they clump, retreat pylon to pylon.
plan.late: Late, Construct Additional Pylons makes objectives fortresses; caught without a field you are the slowest squishy alive.

probius.solo: Zone-control offlaner: pylons and rifts hold waves forever and deny trades, but dive bruisers demolish him one on one.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds a clump on your armed Warp Rift for a full Disruption Pulse detonation
combos.diablo: Diablo Apocalypse stuns them over your Warp Rift so Disruption Pulse detonates for big burst
combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows them onto your Warp Rift for the Disruption Pulse explosion
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them on your armed Warp Rift for a guaranteed detonation

build_why: Quest ramps your Warp Rift explosion damage, your main poke and burst engine, complete it early to two-shot squishies.
Free spell armor whenever a cannon is up, keeps fragile Probius alive against mage poke while you hold zone.
Turns a detonated Rift into a 4-pulse nuke, massive burst on a clumped or rooted target after you land pulses.
Your defensive ult, turns pylons into turrets to wall off a lane and defend a point in a 5v5.
Pylons shield your whole team, take it over damage when you need to enable a dive or protect the carry.
Extends the Rift slow so a stepped-on target stays snared long enough for your combo or an ally gank to land.
Three pylons means map-wide vision and stacked Overcharge zones, locks down any objective fight.

plan.early: Stutter-step autos to stack Give 'Em Some Pepper, Inspire on the wave to shove, and hold Penetrating Round purely to peel ganks.
plan.mid: Raynor's Raider at 10: drop the banshee on the objective tank and keep autoing from max range while Inspire keeps attack speed up.
plan.fight: Backline turret: sit max range, shoot their frontline until a diver commits, then knockback the diver and kite behind your tank.
plan.late: Line 'Em Up range at 13 lets you shred tanks from safety; you die instantly if dived, so never walk first and hug your team.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit pins a clump so your autos and Penetrating Round rip through them
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Balls a target into your Penetrating Round and autos
combos.thrall: Thrall Sundering pins them against the wall for your Penetrating Round and sustained autos
combos.ltmorales: Lt. Morales Stim Drone jacks your attack speed so your autos and Penetrating Round shred

build_why: Bonus damage to slowed targets plus a slow on your knockback, rewards your peel and chunks divers.
Lower cooldown and armor on Adrenaline Rush, the sustain and survival that keeps an immobile carry alive.
Boosts your only self-peel and poke, take it to shove a diver off you and chunk their frontline from range.
Big AoE zoning ult that pressures the whole fight and objectives, the standard pick over the raid heroic.
Cuts Penetrating Round cooldown, more when it hits 2+, near-constant peel and poke in grouped fights.
More Penetrating Round damage plus heavy self-heal, turns your peel into real burst and sustain.
Shorter death timer and a free Hyperion on death, keeps you in the game and punishes them for the kill.

plan.early: Offlane: park a Mirror Image side-lane to double-soak, duel with Image Transmission swaps, Wind Walk out before the gank arrives.
plan.mid: Bladestorm at 10: spin when they clump on your team at the objective, or clear the point solo while your images hold tower aggro.
plan.fight: Enter on clones, Critical Strike the squishiest target, Image Transmission out the moment you are focused. Clean fights, never start them.
plan.late: Late you win by split-pushing side lanes and swapping out of every collapse; the risk is ARAM comps that never give you a map to use.

samuro.solo: Premier solo laner and camp thief: clones tank everything and almost nobody pins him; Stukov's silence and AoE cleave ruin the images.

combos.abathur: Abathur Symbiote shields your Mirror Image dive so your Critical Strike autos keep swinging
combos.deckard: Deckard Stay Awhile and Listen sleeps them so your Mirror Image and Critical Strike autos burst free
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a target for your Mirror Image and Critical Strike burst
combos.sylvanas: Sylvanas Wailing Arrow silences so your Mirror Image dive and Critical Strike autos go uninterrupted

build_why: Guaranteed crit every 3rd attack, the reliable damage backbone for your images and split push.
Armor during and after Wind Walk, the survivability that makes you nearly unkillable in a dive or escape.
Crits add AoE spell damage, boosts your waveclear and cleave in grouped fights.
AoE burst plus armor, your teamfight and waveclear ult when you are grouped rather than split.
Wind Walk leaves a decoy image that keeps acting, free clone for pressure and the ultimate juke tool.
Attacking out of Wind Walk amps your damage on that target, a huge burst opener on a squishy.
Shorter Wind Walk cooldown, more escapes, more Harsh Winds openers, more constant map pressure.

sgthammer.note: Siege from another zip code, needs protection
sgthammer.why: 47.7% wr: immobile siege, feast or famine

plan.early: Siege behind your gate at max Artillery range, mine the flank bush, and unsiege the second their frontline steps toward you.
plan.mid: Blunt Force Gun at 10: fire it across the objective to finish runners or wipe the wave; stay sieged behind your team, never ahead.
plan.fight: Win by sieging where they can't reach: shell their frontline, keep Thrusters banked for the one dive, Spider Mines behind you.
plan.late: Advanced Artillery range shells keeps from outside tower range, that ends games; one Stitches hook or lockdown chain deletes you.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit pins a clump so your Siege Mode autos and Spider Mines shred the group
combos.johanna: Johanna Blessed Shield stuns so your Siege Mode autos land free from the backline
combos.ltmorales: Lt. Morales Stim Drone boosts your Siege Mode attack speed so autos delete their front line
combos.ana: Ana Nano Boost amps your Siege Mode autos so each long-range shot hits far harder

sgthammer.trait_tip: Siege Mode (trait) when safe and stationary for +100% range and splash to melt structures or clumped enemies; exit it the moment you must reposition.
build_why: Bigger, harder Siege Mode splash, multiplies your zone and structure pressure, the core of Hammer damage.
Cheaper Concussive Blast plus a wall, peel divers off you and block a choke to save your fragile self.
Move while sieged, the mobility fix for Hammer's biggest weakness so you can reposition under pressure.
Long-range line nuke for poke and picks, softens the enemy before a fight from total safety.
Mine trail while thrusting, self-peel and area denial that punishes anyone chasing you.
Shield plus attack damage on Neosteel, survives a dive and spikes your burst window.
Blunt Force Gun orbits the map repeatedly, permanent global damage that zones and chips objectives.

sylvanas.note: Trait shuts down structures, push machine
sylvanas.why: 54.1% wr + 27% ban on a big sample: deletes structures, wins every map

plan.early: Stack Black Arrows fast: shove with Withering Fire, poke structures with the trait stun, and keep Haunting Wave strictly as escape.
plan.mid: Mind Control at 10: on objectives drag their tank out of position, and your trait locks towers so your team dives gates for free.
plan.fight: Spread Black Arrows with autos from the second row, save Haunting Wave to dodge the engage; you shoot, you never frontline.
plan.late: Late you delete keeps in seconds: push a side lane to force a split, then Mind Control the flanker they send into your team.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit pins a clump for your Wailing Arrow silence and Withering Fire
combos.diablo: Diablo Apocalypse stuns the team so your Shadow Dagger spreads and Withering Fire rakes them
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc suspends a target for your Wailing Arrow and Withering Fire to load up
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them so your Shadow Dagger spread and Withering Fire stick

sylvanas.trait_tip: Black Arrows (trait) before hitting a merc camp, structures, or the core: 10s of your attacks stunning non-Heroes lets you capture and backdoor uncontested.
build_why: Stacking attack speed and spell power on hero hits, ramps your DPS the longer you fire in a fight.
Dying minions explode, monstrous waveclear and camp clear that fuels Sylvanas's push identity.
The 5th Withering Fire on one target hits huge, real single-target burst to actually threaten kills.
Your AoE silence ult, take it to shut off their combo or engage, and it clears a lane instantly.
Shadow Dagger shreds armor on spread, opens the whole clumped team for your and allies' follow-up.
Move speed on hits, the kiting tool that keeps immobile Sylvanas alive while she pumps damage.
Wailing Arrow center hits harder and silences longer, turns your utility ult into burst and lockdown.

tracer.why: 54.4% wr (thin sample): untouchable in good hands

plan.early: Roam between lanes finishing low targets, keep one Blink charge banked at all times, and Recall out of any trade gone wrong.
plan.mid: Level 10 upgrades your bomb: take Sticky Bomb, stick the healer on engage, and Blink clear before the pop; the slow strands them.
plan.fight: Weave onto the backline, dump full clips into the healer, Blink sideways through skillshots, Recall only when Blinks are spent.
plan.late: Late you win by never dying: drag chasers away from the fight, reload behind pillars, and let their respawn timers end the game.

combos.tassadar: Tassadar Plasma Shield keeps you alive to empty full clips into their backline
combos.abathur: Abathur Symbiote hat shields you and adds spikes as you unload your pistols
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a target for an uninterrupted clip and Pulse Bomb
combos.anduin: Anduin Chastise roots a target so you dump a full clip and stick Pulse Bomb

tracer.trait_tip: Reload (trait) manually behind cover or after a Blink so you are never caught mid-reload in a fight; time it during downtime, not while a kill is in range.
build_why: Extra melee charge for reset harass; poke the backline between reloads and feed Telefrag's cooldown later.
Globe sustain keeps you in their face; with no escape but position, this is your lifeline.
The DPS pick: faster reload is flat 20% more damage, and your whole kit is basic attacks.
Percent-health bomb finishes tanks and squishies alike, your only real burst on an auto-attacker.
Recall CDR plus unstoppable arrival: dive in, dump the clip, blink out safe, the survival backbone.
AoE melee resets clear waves and hit clumped backliners, and every hit shaves Recall's cooldown.
Double bomb doubles your burst, near-guarantees the squishy kill once you stick it.

tychus.why: 52.6% wr: best tank-shredder in the game

plan.early: Short range means patience: clear waves with Overkill, Run and Gun to dodge the gank angle, and trade only when Minigun is up.
plan.mid: Commandeer Odin at 10: stomp in as the objective starts; its range fixes your short arm and forces them to scatter or melt.
plan.fight: Shred the frontline: Minigun their tank for percent damage, Run and Gun out of dives, and hold Frag Grenade to peel for yourself.
plan.late: Late you beat every tank comp; the risk is your 4.5 range, so wait for their engage, then Odin second-line and burn the biggest target.

combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball throws their backline into your Minigun range
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds a clump still for your Minigun to melt
combos.dehaka: Dehaka Drag tongues a straggler into your Minigun and Overkill
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target still for your Minigun to spin up on

tychus.trait_tip: Minigun (trait) right as a fight starts and stay on the highest-Health target: it adds 2.5% of their max Health per hit for 3s, so uptime on tanks is huge.
build_why: Range is Tychus's lifeblood; an extra tile lets you shred tanks while staying out of melee.
The core quest: permanent Minigun uptime is your whole damage identity, start stacking early.
Armor when stunned or rooted; you're the dive target, so this keeps you firing through their CC.
Your range fix and survival tool, drop the Odin to stomp the objective fight and out-range their dive.
Minigun self-heal sustains you through long fights so you never have to back off DPS.
Percent-health on the grenade with cooldown refund, adds burst to your sustained tank-melting.
Longer Odin plus a nuke turns your ult into a fight-ending AoE bomb.

plan.early: Gank from Vanish: open Cheap Shot on overextended squishies, Sinister Strike out; you tax lanes with kill pressure, not soak.

plan.late: Late you own the fog: a pick before the objective wins the game, but breaking stealth to a stray AoE near their team is the throw.

combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball tosses a target to you for a full Ambush combo from stealth
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit locks a target so you land your whole Cheap Shot to Eviscerate combo
combos.thrall: Thrall Feral Spirit roots a target for your Garrote and Ambush burst
combos.abathur: Abathur Symbiote hat shields you so you commit to a longer backstab combo

valeera.trait_tip: Vanish (trait) to open or reset a fight: it restealths and refreshes your combo openers, so stack combo points then burst a squishy from cloak.
build_why: More energy regen and a higher cap let you chain the full combo without running dry.
Cheaper Sinister Strike means more combo throughput, spam it in the burst window.
Both blades for big burst, the pick when you want to delete a squishy on the opener.
Escape plus armor bubble, the survival ult that lets you dive deep and still get out.
Ambush teleport cuts Vanish's cooldown, re-stealth faster to reset your assassination.
Instant energy without breaking stealth, refuels mid-combo to finish the kill.
Huge energy regen inside Smoke Bomb, unload a whole combo while untargetable.

valla.note: Safe hypercarry, Q build kites everything
valla.why: 49.5% wr on the biggest sample: reliable ranged damage

plan.early: Keep Hatred at 10 stacks by tagging something every 5 seconds, clear with Multishot, and treat Vault as your escape, not a toy.
plan.mid: Rain of Vengeance at 10: hold it to peel the diver off you or to chain stuns after your tank engages, never as opening poke.
plan.fight: Max-range autos on the closest safe target, Multishot to reveal stealth, and Vault away the instant a melee turns toward you.
plan.late: Manticore at 16 shreds tanks; late you win any autos-only fight but die to one gank, so never walk the map alone.

combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows a clump so your Multishot and Hungering Arrow shred them
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball throws a target into your Hungering Arrow and Multishot
combos.auriel: Auriel Detainment Strike stuns a target into a wall for your focused Hungering Arrow
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target for your point-blank Multishot and Hungering Arrow

build_why: The Q-build quest: extra bounce plus permanent damage stacks, your poke and kite backbone.
Free Vault that resets Hungering Arrow, fire and reposition, the kite engine.
Bonus PvE damage secures camps and bosses fast to snowball map control.
Move-and-shoot burst, the safe DPS ult that lets you kite while dumping damage.
Lifesteal on Q and W keeps a squishy backliner topped up through the fight.
Percent-health every 3rd auto, your tank-shredding scaling for the late game.
Longer Strafe with penetrating bolts turns your ult into sustained AoE carry damage.

zagara.why: 48.5% wr: lane bully, falls off in fights

plan.early: Plant creep tumors every trip, shove with Banelings plus Infested Drop, and out-rotate: your speed and vision on creep win the map.
plan.mid: Devouring Maw at 10: swallow their healer plus a chaser on engage and kill the players left outside before it spits them back.
plan.fight: Sit max range on creep, Hunter Killer the squishiest target, Infested Drop on cooldown, and never get caught off creep by a diver.
plan.late: Late, shove side lanes before every fight and seed tumors deep; if they group your push wins, if they split Maw punishes the 4v5.

zagara.solo: Strong solo laner on big maps: trades with Hunter Killer, soaks safely behind creep vision, and is hard to gank on her own turf.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit clumps enemies right on your Banelings and Devouring Maw
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes a group for your Banelings and Devouring Maw
combos.deckard: Deckard Scroll of Sealing walls enemies in for your Devouring Maw and Baneling volleys

zagara.trait_tip: Creep Tumor (trait): seed tumors for map vision and +20% Move Speed on Creep; drop one before objectives or to watch flanks, and keep charges banked.
build_why: Longer baneling range, poke and zone from safety, chip their frontline before the fight.
A big auto DoT, real single-target damage to punish anyone who steps up.
The Infested Drop quest, more roachlings and radius, boosts wave-clear and zone pressure.
Map-wide teleport off your creep, the macro ult, soak and rotate anywhere instantly.
Hunter Killers heal you, sustaining your zoning as a squishy specialist.
Percent-health from your creatures adds tank-shredding to back up your zone.
Stronger Devouring Maw with takedown CDR, your one real teamfight CC, spam it.

plan.early: Gank with Cleave burst from stealth, Blink in only when the exit is safe, and take camps between ganks; you don't sit in a lane.
plan.mid: Void Prison at 10: trap half their team on the objective and kill the outsiders, or Prison the rescuer to seal a pick.
plan.fight: Cleave plus autos on the healer, Blink to disjoint the return skillshot, Wormhole back out, re-stealth, and re-enter on cooldown.
plan.late: Late one good Prison wins the game: cut their frontline from backline at the choke; the risk is face-checking bushes into CC chains.

combos.abathur: Abathur Symbiote hat shields and spikes you through a deeper backline burst
combos.diablo: Diablo Shadow Charge stuns a target for your Singularity Spike and Cleave burst
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball throws a target to you for a full Singularity Spike combo
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes a target you delete with Singularity Spike and Cleave

zeratul.trait_tip: Permanent Cloak (trait): stay out of combat to restealth and stand still 1.5s to go Invisible; approach unseen and pick your engage angle before you strike.
build_why: Wider cleave means better wave-clear and multi-target harass while you roam.
Cleave DoT adds sustained damage to your blink-in combos.
Blink out and back, the survival talent, dive the backline and escape the collapse.
The reason you draft Zeratul: a time-stop that wins 5v5s, isolate their core or save your team.
A shield from staying cloaked lets you survive the burst when you dive deep.
Cleave hitting multiple heroes deals more with CDR, ramping your teamfight damage.
A takedown resets your abilities, chain a second blink combo to clean up the fight.

plan.early: Angle Twin Cleave through the wave onto their hero, channel Regeneration only from fog, and stack You Want Axe? without dying.
plan.mid: Taz'dingo at 10: flip it the moment their combo starts, then Berserker to max attack speed and stand in their face for 4 free seconds.
plan.fight: Ride low health on purpose for trait attack speed, shred the nearest tank, and Taz'dingo turns their all-in into your best fight.
plan.late: Amani Resilience at 20 makes Taz'dingo heal you back up; your real risk is being stunned before you press it, watch their CC first.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds a group for your Berserker auto-attacks and Guillotine
combos.tassadar: Tassadar Plasma Shield lets you stand and unload auto-attacks safely
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns a target for your Grievous Throw and steady axe fire
combos.medivh: Medivh Ley Line Seal freezes enemies for your Guillotine and Grievous Throw

zuljin.trait_tip: Berserker (trait): toggle on for +25% Attack Damage when you can trade safely, but it drains 2% max Health per hit, so keep lifesteal or sustain up.
build_why: Grievous Throw pierces and its mark sticks, setting up your No Mercy execute on the whole line.
Stronger Regeneration plus mana refund, your only real sustain, keeps the berserker topped up.
More Berserker attack speed, flat DPS scaling as your health drops, core to the identity.
Can't die for 4 seconds, the pick versus burst, unload free damage while they can't kill you.
Stronger Twin Cleave slow, a self-peel and kite tool for a hero with no escape.
Autos ignore armor and add percent-health on marked targets, your tank-melting spike.
Guillotine pierces and full-heals on a kill, a global execute that refills your health bar.

murky.note: Annoyance engine, trades time for value

plan.early: Hide the Egg deep in bushes, shove nonstop with Slime and Pufferfish, and trade your cheap deaths for their cooldowns and XP.
plan.mid: Octo-Grab at 10: waddle in and lock their healer or Hammer as your team dives, and call the target first so the stun isn't wasted.
plan.fight: Be the distraction: soak abilities up front, Safety Bubble through the burst, and Slime everything so your team cleans up the slowed mess.
plan.late: Late your death still only costs them time: keep the Egg moved, push the lane your team isn't in, and Grab the carry when they group.

murky.solo: Classic nuisance offlaner: rarely wins the 1v1 kill but never leaves, out-soaks through Egg respawns, and starves their bruiser.

combos.johanna: Johanna Blessed Shield stuns so your Pufferfish arms right on top of them for the full detonation
combos.zarya: Zarya Graviton Surge clumps them over your Pufferfish for a guaranteed detonation
combos.brightwing: Brightwing Polymorph locks a target on your Pufferfish so it blows up in their face

murky.trait_tip: Spawn Egg (trait): tuck your Egg in a bush near the fight so you respawn in 8s; move it forward as you push and never leave it exposed to enemies.
build_why: Hides your real egg among decoys and buffs your respawn, keep them guessing and stay unkillable.
Protects your bomb from being popped and rewards sliming first, your main teamfight and wave damage.
Turns your bubble into an escape and engage tool, dodge in and out of their whole team untouched.
A guaranteed 3-second lockdown, pin their carry so your team collapses, your real teamfight contribution.
Full sustain every bubble, makes you even more of a time-wasting nuisance they can't kill.
Auto-applies your slime for constant DPS, ramps your in-your-face auto-attack harassment.
Doubles your HP for real teamfight staying power, trade the fast respawn to become a bruiser.

plan.early: Offlane: keep Carnage bleeds rolling and pop Blood Rage to heal off the wave plus the laner. Grappling Hook over terrain for free ganks.
plan.mid: Final Strike at 10: bleed them down, Revolving Sweep to stick, then line the execute through both carries on the objective.
plan.fight: Revolving Sweep their carry to dodge damage while attached, drop the stun, spread bleeds, Blood Rage once three are marked.
plan.late: Late she snipes kills with Final Strike off any chip damage; knockback peel like E.T.C. blanks Sweep, engage after their CC is burned.

qhira.solo: Strong solo laner: bleeds plus Blood Rage outsustain most bruisers and Hook makes her ungankable; hard CC ganks and Yrel beat her.

combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns so your Unrelenting Strikes channel and Carnage bleed land full
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Bloodlust and Lightning Shield amp your dive so Carnage and Unrelenting Strikes shred
combos.abathur: Abathur Symbiote shields and spikes your dive so Carnage and Unrelenting Strikes stay committed
combos.anubarak: Anub'arak Impale stuns so your Unrelenting Strikes channel and Carnage bleed connect

qhira.trait_tip: Grappling Hook (trait) to engage: hitting an enemy launches and kicks them. Aim at terrain behind a target to reposition, or use it to escape over walls.
build_why: Quest ramps your bleed and adds an execute on low targets, the core of Qhira DPS, rush it to snowball.
Evade on hitting 2 heroes with Blood Rage, your survival tool that lets you commit into a bruiser and live.
Carnage lifesteal plus an empowered follow-up attack, sustains you in duels and chunks the target.
Your teamfight ult, a growing sword that pumps AoE and ends in a burst, take it in grouped fights.
Refreshes Carnage while a target is at max bleed, near-permanent access to your gap-close and sustain.
Armor shred on your grapples, opens the target for your own burst and your team's follow-up.
Adds a silence to Unrelenting Strikes, locks down a mobile or channel-reliant target while you shred them.

lostvikings.note: Triple soak wins XP, needs macro brain
lostvikings.why: 53.9% wr on 104 games: macro gods in expert hands, useless otherwise

plan.early: Three lanes, three Vikings: Olaf takes the dangerous lane, Erik roams the edges, Baleog clears; soak every wave, hit talent spikes first.
plan.mid: Play Again at 10 on big maps: keep soaking until the objective goes live, then summon all three in fresh; Erik stalls channels.
plan.fight: Never clump: Olaf body-blocks and charges to peel, Baleog spins the wave, Erik kites wide; losing one Viking is fine, three is a wipe.
plan.late: The XP lead is the win condition: you reach 20 first, so force fights at your spike and never let a Viking die shown on the map.

lostvikings.solo: Not one solo laner but three: they win the soak war outright, and collapsing on one Viking still leaves two earning elsewhere.

combos.zarya: Zarya Graviton Surge bunches enemies for your Longboat Raid and Spin to Win
combos.sylvanas: Sylvanas Wailing Arrow silences a group for your Longboat Raid barrage
combos.sgthammer: Sgt. Hammer sieges from range while your Vikings soak and split-push all lanes
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball groups enemies for your Longboat Raid cannon fire

lostvikings.trait_tip: Spread all three Vikings on separate lanes to soak XP, then pull them together with Longboat or before a fight; never leave them scattered when 5v5 starts.
build_why: Beefs up your durable Viking with health and periodic armor, so Olaf can hold a lane and eat a gank attempt.
Erik moves faster and self-heals on the go, the mobility that makes triple-lane soak and escapes reliable.
An on-demand shield across all three, your panic button to survive a collapse and keep your soakers alive.
Bundles the Vikings into a fighting boat, the ult that lets them contest teamfights and push, not just soak.
Invulnerability and pass-through for all Vikings, the ungankable escape when they finally catch a lone body.
Go Go Go bursts speed and breaks roots, your rotation and disengage tool to keep all three lanes covered.
Halves the death timer, so a caught Viking is back soaking almost immediately, minimizing the lost XP.

arthas.why: 49.4% wr: melee-killer aura, slows win brawls

plan.early: Trade with Death Coil, root predictable paths with Howling Blast, toggle Frozen Tempest only in trades; it drains mana fast
plan.mid: Sindragosa at 10: hit 3+ heroes or freeze the fort before you push; disabled towers make your objective follow-up free
plan.fight: Walk through their front to the AA carry, Tempest halves attack speed, Howling Blast the dash as it starts. Enter last, no escape
plan.late: Frostmourne Hungers plus Remorseless Winter at 16 melts anyone in melee; displacement is death, so hug your team and walls

arthas.solo: Strong solo vs melee: Frozen Tempest ruins AA bruisers; ranged offlaners kite him for free and Ana cuts his self-heal

combos.chromie: Chromie's Slowing Sands and Sand Blast set up your Howling Blast root and Frostmourne Hunger dive
combos.maiev: Maiev's Containment Disc suspends a target for your Frostmourne Hunger and Howling Blast follow-up
combos.zarya: Zarya's Graviton Surge sucks them into a clump for your Frozen Tempest and Army of the Dead to grind
combos.rehgar: Rehgar's Earthbind Totem slow keeps them in your Frozen Tempest while Bloodlust fuels your dive

arthas.trait_tip: Frostmourne Hungers (trait): activate for an instant empowered attack and 30 Mana back; weave it to reset attack timing on a fleeing target.
build_why: Solves your mana and adds damage, keeps Frostmourne Hungers online so you spam abilities.
Ramps attack speed the longer you brawl inside Frozen Tempest, your sustained-damage identity.
Lets you sling Death Coil offensively and still self-heal, flexible sustain in a fight.
Huge AoE slow that wins brawls and disables structures, your teamfight-control ult.
Armor shred on Howling Blast so your team focuses the slowed target down faster.
Roots anyone who lingers in your aura, punishing melee that tries to trade with you.
A ghoul army for extra damage and sustain, great for split-push and brawl pressure.

hogger.why: 54.2% wr, unanimous S in every source: rage sustain + wall slams

plan.early: Throw Loot Hoard for the meat heal, Staggering Blow enemies into it or walls for stuns, keep Rage above 50 by trading often
plan.mid: Hoardapult at 10: launch onto their backline at objectives, Hogg Wild spin the clump, Staggering Blow stragglers into terrain
plan.fight: Pin their carry to a wall with Staggering Blow, point-blank Ez-Thro Dynamite so it pops instantly, spin out with Hogg Wild
plan.late: No wall means no stun: pick fight locations first. Stay above 50 Rage for the armor or you fall over in seconds

hogger.solo: Premier offlaner: wins most melee matchups with wall stuns and meat sustain; poke ranged like Lunara starve him out

combos.diablo: Diablo Shadow Charge knocks a hero into your Loot Hoard for the Ez-Thro Dynamite combo
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns a target for your Ez-Thro Dynamite and Hogg Wild spin
combos.liming: Li-Ming Slow and Magic Missiles pin them so your Dynamite and Staggering Blow land
combos.stukov: Stukov Lurking Arm silences and slows them onto your Loot Hoard and Dynamite

hogger.trait_tip: Loot Hoard (trait): toss it to knock a diving enemy away or block a chokepoint; the junk pile is terrain, so drop it between you and a chaser.
build_why: Rage on demand plus rage-scaled healing, your lane sustain and the fuel to keep abilities firing in a brawl.
Auto-attack quest that permanently ups your damage, plus more Loot Hoard reach for wall-slam setups.
Loads extra dynamite into your combo, the burst spike that turns a wall-stun into a kill.
Your ranged engage, ride the hoard onto their backline with a slow attached to lock a target down.
Armor through your Hogg Wild spin, take it vs burst so you survive diving into their line.
Payoff for the wall-slam: longer stun and bonus max-health damage make your signature combo lethal.
Turns Hoardapult into a dynamite machine gun, huge zone pressure and follow-up after the engage.

maiev.note: Cage the fight, umbral bind cleave
maiev.why: 46.9% wr this patch (volatile): cage plays still win fights

plan.early: Fan of Knives resets clear waves instantly; rotate and set ganks with Umbral Bind from bushes. Hold Vault to escape, never to engage.
plan.mid: Containment Disc at 10: disc the healer or a Cho'gall at objective start, then Umbral Bind the rest back into your team's AoE.
plan.fight: Spirit of Vengeance in, Umbral Bind two or more, drag them back into your team. Hold Fan of Knives until it hits at least two heroes.
plan.late: Late she chain-fights off Fan resets and the Disc pick decides fights. Unstoppable and cleanse blank the Bind, track those cooldowns.

maiev.solo: Not a real solo laner: no sustain and her value is roam ganks; if forced, clear fast with Fan and rotate rather than trade.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit stacks the team inside your Containment Disc and Warden's Cage
combos.blaze: Blaze Combustion stuns grouped enemies for your Fan of Knives and Umbral Bind
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost locks them for your Warden's Cage and Fan of Knives
combos.deckard: Deckard Horadric Cube stuns and slows a target for your Spirit of Vengeance pull

maiev.trait_tip: Vault of the Wardens (trait): leap as a key stun or skillshot lands; the 0.75s immunity dodges it entirely, so react to the enemy cast, not on cooldown.
build_why: Keeps Spirit of Vengeance up nonstop, your engage and escape tool comes back faster the more you tether.
Rewards hitting clumps with your cleave, complete it and your AoE burst and wave clear spike hard.
Amps the follow-up on a pinned target, the armor shred sets up your team to delete them.
Take a key target out of the fight for 4 seconds, isolate their tank or delay a save during your dive.
Free survivability when you cleave a clump, lets you dive into multiple enemies and live.
Adds percent-health burst to your cleave, take it to melt tanks alongside the squishies.
Double-engage or double-escape on demand, chain your wall combos or bail from a lost fight.

mei.why: 47.9% wr: stall kit, low kill pressure

plan.early: Offlane on blind uptime: Snow Blind every trade so melee whiff, Icing out of ganks, Cryo-Freeze baits their full combo for free.
plan.mid: Ice Wall at 10: cut their frontline off from the healer on the objective, or wall the choke so they enter the fight in halves.
plan.fight: Peel machine: blind the enemy auto-attacker on cooldown, Blizzard the clump for the stun, Cryo-Freeze the burst aimed at you.
plan.late: Late one good Ice Wall wins the fight before it starts; the risk is walling YOUR team wrong. Breathe, cut their backline, not yours.

mei.solo: Great solo lane vs auto-attack melee: Snow Blind makes Butcher and Illidan whiff; loses to poke like Hanzo who never touches her blind.

combos.xul: Xul Bone Prison roots a target for your Blizzard and Ice Wall trap
combos.lunara: Lunara Crippling Spores slows them into your Snow Bank and Ice Wall zoning
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes the group inside your Ice Wall and Blizzard
combos.deckard: Deckard Horadric Cube stuns a target for your Blizzard and Cryo-Freeze burst

mei.trait_tip: Cryo-Freeze (trait): freeze to break CC and survive burst, but you can't act while frozen, so time it to bait key cooldowns and thaw into the follow-up.
build_why: Buffs your main setup, more Blizzard damage and a beefier stun to lock a clump for your team.
Stronger blind for peel and it shuts off forts, take it for both teamfight and siege pressure.
Turns Blizzard into a defensive zone, drop it on your team to gut their burst in a fight.
Your grab-and-displace ult, roll their backline into your team or peel a whole dive off your carry.
Refreshes your abilities while invulnerable, freeze mid-fight then come out with everything up.
Double blind uptime, lock down two auto-attackers or extend your peel across a longer fight.
A free second life every fight, bait their whole combo then walk away, cementing your unkillable peel.
